# Agent Community — Bots for DeepSeek Harness **Persistent Bots, group rooms and a durable run ledger, inside DSH.** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](DESIGN.md) · [MIT](LICENSE) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-2563eb.svg)](#requirements) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> A community-maintained DeepSeek Harness plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. A Bot here is not a temporary subagent: it has an identity, its own model and permission preset, its own workspace, and its own session that survives a restart. Put several of them in a room and they answer together. Every run is recorded, so a conversation can be read back later even after the session that produced it is gone.

## Features - **Bots that persist.** Each Bot keeps a name, a model, a permission preset and a workspace on disk. It is listed in the panel and answers in any room it belongs to, before and after a restart. - **One-to-one and group conversations.** A room is a list of members. A message addressed to one Bot routes to that Bot; a message addressed to nobody in particular is answered by every member, because a greeting is addressed to the room. - **Runs are queued, leased and recoverable.** Each answer is a run with a lease and a heartbeat. A run whose runtime dies is reclaimed instead of blocking the room, and a room keeps working while you do something else. - **A durable transcript.** The panel draws from a ledger written as the run happens (messages, tool calls and their results, approvals, errors), not from the session log. Compacted-away history is replaced by a summary rather than silently dropped. - **15 model-facing tools**, so a Bot can create rooms, hand work to another Bot, decompose a request into tasks and report on them: `agent_community_create_bot`, `agent_community_update_bot`, `agent_community_list_bots`, `agent_community_create_room`, `agent_community_send_message`, `agent_community_list_runs`, `agent_community_get_context`, `agent_community_post_message`, `agent_community_task_decompose`, `agent_community_task_assign`, `agent_community_task_status`, `agent_community_task_report`, `agent_community_submit_final`, `agent_community_remember`, `agent_community_deliver`. - **Models come from DSH Settings.** The Bot form and the composer's model menu read the deployment's live catalog — every provider, every model, its display name and its reasoning levels. Nothing about a vendor or a model is hard-coded; a provider added or renamed in Settings appears without restarting. - **File cards for what a Bot delivered.** A Bot declares the files it produced with `agent_community_deliver`; the turn then shows file cards below its reply — preview in the panel, open with the OS application association, or reveal in Finder. Files may live inside the Bot's workspace or at any absolute path. - **A preview dock with real viewers.** Clicking a card opens the split preview dock: **PDF** through a bundled PDF.js (page navigation, zoom, fit width), **`.docx`** through docx-preview (paginated pages, selectable text, fit width), **`.xlsx`/`.csv`** through SheetJS (sheet tabs, frozen header, virtual scrolling). PowerPoint and legacy `.doc`/`.xls` go through the host's Office→PDF conversion into the same PDF viewer. All viewers are bundled into the plugin's single browser artifact (3.3 MB, ~0.9 MB gzipped) — the panel never fetches a viewer from the network. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for their licenses. - **Attachments.** Files and images can be added to a message. They are stored inside the receiving Bot's own workspace and appended to what the model sees; the bubble still shows exactly what you typed. - **Compaction that you can trigger.** `/compact` summarises the older part of a room with the room's own Bot model, keeps the newest messages verbatim, and retires the session that was carrying the old history — so the next answer continues from the summary instead of replaying the transcript. - **Unread state that follows what you actually see.** A read water mark records when you read, not just which message, so a room that has been compacted can still tell you what is new. The room on screen counts as read — its badge clears as soon as it is displayed, and a reply that lands while you are looking at it clears immediately. Only messages that arrive while the DSH window is hidden stay unread, so the count is right when you come back. The badge counts **unread replies** — each bot run is one (so several scheduled runs are several unread, not one) — and a bot's extra post in the same turn does not double-count. ## Requirements | | | | --- | --- | | DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` (built and verified against it; no DSH version is pinned) | | Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` | | pnpm | `11.7.0` (for building from source) | `@deepseek-ai/*` packages are **not** published to the public npm registry, so this repo cannot install them and `pnpm install` alone fails — expected. The plugin deliberately does **not** pin a DSH version: every peer range is `*` and a missing host package degrades at load instead of failing the install. That is also why the plugin is meant to be installed *into* a DSH profile, where the running harness supplies those packages. ## Installation ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-agent-collaboration ``` The published package carries all three packages prebuilt, so nothing is compiled on your machine. Restart DSH and refresh the page — **Bots团队** appears in the sidebar. ### Installing the release tarball instead The archive attached to each release is the same build that is published to npm — use it when you would rather not install through a registry. The line below points at the latest public release; see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for what a newer version changes. ```bash dsh plugin --profile add \ https://github.com/Leo-sail/dsh-plugin-agent-collaboration/releases/download/v0.3.5/dsh-plugin-agent-collaboration-0.3.5.tgz ``` ### Installing from a checkout instead ```bash dsh plugin --profile add "file:/path/to/this/repo/packages/bundle/agent-collaboration" ``` Keep the `file:` prefix. pnpm records a bare absolute path as a `link:` symlink and then installs none of the bundle's own `file:` dependencies; the profile ends up with the bundle and no `@dsh-plugin-agent-community/*` rows, and every row fails to import. The same applies to DSH's own plugin manager, which passes an absolute path through unchanged. Verify the install — all three must be real directories, not symlinks: ```bash ls -ld ~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules/@dsh-plugin-agent-community/* ``` ### Ask an agent to do it ```text Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/Leo-sail/dsh-plugin-agent-collaboration/releases/download/v0.3.5/dsh-plugin-agent-collaboration-0.3.5.tgz into my DSH profile, restart DSH, and confirm the "Bots团队" entry appears in the sidebar. ``` ## Usage | What you want | How | | --- | --- | | Create a Bot | Open **Bots团队** → **＋** → fill in name, model, permission and workspace. The Bot is created immediately and appears in the roster. | | Talk to one Bot | Select it in the **Bots** tab (one-to-one room) and send a message. | | Create a group | **＋** in the **群聊** tab, pick the members. | | Address one member of a group | Type `@` and pick a Bot from the menu, or use its name in the text. Only that Bot is queued. | | Address the whole room | Send a message that names nobody. Every member answers. | | Add a file or image | **＋** → **文件**, or paste/drop it onto the composer. | | Change the model for one room | **＋** → **模型**. Affects the next run, not one already in fl

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-shell-progress)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-shell-progress)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-shell-progress)](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.11-339933)](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/blob/main/package.json)
[![ci](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![harness matrix](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/harness-matrix.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/harness-matrix.yml)
[![release](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg?branch=v0.8.1)](https://github.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/actions/workflows/release.yml)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows **where a multi-step shell command is right
now**, as a segmented progress bar inside the tool-call card.

<!-- Absolute, not `docs/assets/running.png`: npmjs.com renders only the README it
     snapshotted at publish time and does not serve the repository tree, so a relative
     path shows a broken image there. The file still lives in the repo, and
     `pnpm run e2e` rewrites it, so this URL follows the code. -->
![The card while a four-step command runs: a partly filled segmented bar with the step in flight and its clock, the finished step's output beneath it, and the steps still to come](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/main/docs/assets/running.png)

*The real card, expanded, with `3/4` done and step 4 in flight.*

## Features

Collapsed, the card's summary row carries a segmented bar, one segment per top-level step (pending, running or done), beside a `3/4` counter, so where the command is and how many steps are left read at a glance. Hover a segment and it opens that step's card, showing its command line, its output and its time.

![The card a segment opens on hover: a line of prose above the command, then that step's output and time](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9087/dsh-shell-progress/main/docs/assets/hover.png)

In the hover card, each step gets a one-line comment above its command line, spelling out what that line is for. (The lines come from the model, written alongside the command so a run never waits for them; each distinct command is asked for once, and a card whose notes missed the record fetches them the first time you hover or open it. They can be switched off on the DSH Settings page under "Shell Progress" and are on by default.)

Expanding the card shows the command's steps, one row each: the line's command, plus its time and output; the step in flight carries a running clock.

A command the model runs in the background (`run_in_background: true`) is a job, and its card says so: the title reads "run a background job", with the warning mark beside it explaining on hover, and no bar or counter — the record is written the moment the job starts, so a bar could only claim a position it never saw. Expanding the card lists the command's statements; the output stays with the shell, in the **Background jobs** list at the top of the conversation, which also stops the job. The command runs unmodified (so its output is byte-exact), and a long build or test suite no longer holds the turn while it runs.

A command that cannot be split, or that the plugin declines to track, is still ONE command: the card draws one segment, and a `⚠` after the title explains on hover that the command was not split, so the bar describes the whole command rather than per-step progress. The command itself runs exactly as it does under the `pwsh` tool, and its output obeys the same per-step budget.

## Install

In DSH, open the **Plugins** page and click **Add plugin**, then enter `dsh-shell-progress` (the npm package name).

Or from the command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-shell-progress
```

Or mount it by hand in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: shell-progress
      name: dsh-shell-progress
```

Either way, restart `dsh web` afterwards (the host loads plugins once, at start-up).

## Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: shell-progress
      name: dsh-shell-progress
      config:
        enabled: true
        pollIntervalMs: 120
        maxStepOutputChars: 8192
        maxSteps: 400
        liveRetentionMs: 300000
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the `shell_progress` tool. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `120` | How often the host reads the running process's output. |
| `maxStepOutputChars` | `8192` | Per-step output kept in the persisted progress. |
| `maxSteps` | `400` | A command split into more steps than this runs unmodified. |
| `liveRetentionMs` | `300000` | How long a settled call's live record is kept for a late poll. |

When a step's output passes `maxStepOutputChars`, the lines that do not fit are dropped from
the CARD's copy, and that step's output is followed by the number of characters that are
missing (in the step list and in the segment's hover card alike). Without it a truncated
step reads exactly like a quiet one. The budget is the card's memory, not the tool result:
the model-visible stdout comes from the shell seam and is unaffected by it (the seam's own
`truncated` / `spillPath` reporting applies as it always does).

## Development

Development, testing and publishing details live in [DEVELOP.md](DEVELOP.md) and [PUBLISH.md](PUBLISH.md).

## License

plugins.description: 团队插话助手 · DSH Team Flow. Steer during Agent Teams waits while teammates keep running. Alpha.
plugins.readme_text:
# 团队插话助手 · DSH Team Flow

[English](README.en.md) · [市场安装](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/) · [下载预览版](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/releases) · [试用说明与反馈](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/discussions/1) · [验证记录](docs/verification.md)

**主代理等待队友时，让用户的 Steer 结束这一次等待，队友继续工作。**

DSH Agent Teams 的 Lead 可能停在 `wait_agent` 中。新消息虽进入收件箱，仍要等 Team 变化或 timeout 后才能被下一步领取。Team Flow 是围绕 [Discussion #9214](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9214) 的独立插件实现：仅结束本次 wait，再由原生 AgentLoop 领取原消息。

这是 **alpha 预览版**。无需修改宿主源码或安装文件，但使用运行时方法装饰，尚未验证正式 Desktop UI、SSH、Python PTC 与任意第三方插件组合。请先在隔离 profile 试用。

## 已验证的行为

| 输入 / 条件 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 同一 Lead 的 user Steer | 本次 wait 返回 `{timedOut:false, reason:'user-steer'}`，原消息恰好一次领取 |
| Queue、user-sourced inject、普通 send、直接 Inbox mutation | 不归因为 Steer 唤醒 |
| 其他会话 / teammate 输入 | 不直接结束这里的 Lead 等待 |
| Stop、guard 拒绝、Team-first、原生 timeout | 保留各自结果 |
| 真实 Node PTC | 成功唤醒后，后续程序语句继续执行 |
| 禁用插件时仍在 wait | 仅取消这个 wait，返回明确的插件禁用错误，队友继续运行 |

当前公开源码矩阵：**0.2.1-alpha.1 / alpha.2** 各 17 项通过、跳过 1 项 rc.2+ 专属的 interrupt 检查；**0.2.1-rc.2** 与 **0.2.1-rc.3**（默认 pinned 宿主）均为 18/18。四档均有严格 TypeScript 检查与 Windows CI。旧安装版 **0.2.0-rc.2** 的 16/16 和 Desktop 自带 Node 24.18.1 补测属于历史证据，与新版宿主不同，详见[统一验证矩阵](docs/verification.md)。每档含重复 Steer 和真实 Node PTC；这些数字是隔离 Mock 功能验证，不是完整 Desktop UI、生产延迟或真实模型响应指标。

**2026-10-18 更新：官方最新版 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 已通过 18/18 项隔离测试与严格 TypeScript 检查**，包含真实 Node PTC，以及新版 `interrupt=false` 配置下的 Steer 唤醒。对应插件版本 `0.2.0-alpha.5`；[源码与验证记录](docs/compatibility-0.2.1-rc.2.md)。兼容目标仍从原先的 `0.2.0-rc.2` 起，不强制旧用户升级宿主。

**2026-10-24 更新：官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`（`1f81c047`）已通过 18/18 项隔离测试与严格 TypeScript 检查，并成为默认 pinned 宿主；对应插件版本 `0.2.0-alpha.7`**。rc.2 → rc.3 未改变本插件绑定的任何核心契约（详见[rc.3 兼容报告](docs/compatibility-0.2.1-rc.3.md)）。

## 安装

需要 **DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2、Node >=24**，并先启用官方 **Agent Teams**。已收录 [DSH Market](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/)，2026-10-20 核查公开目录已同步到 alpha.5。可在市场搜索 `dsh-team-flow`，核对来源 `jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow` 后安装；也可使用下面的 Release 安装方式。兼容范围见 [rc.2 验证记录](docs/compatibility-0.2.1-rc.2.md)。

1. 让所有 Agent idle，并备份自己的 profile 配置。建议先使用新的测试 profile。
2. 先启用官方 **Agent Teams** bundle。
3. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/releases) 下载 `dsh-team-flow-continuous-*.tgz`，在 DSH 插件管理器安装本地包；也可使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <你的测试profile> add <tgz绝对路径>
```

4. 确保本插件 bundle 在 Agent Teams bundle **之后**。包已声明 `dsh.bundle.order.after`，市场诊断可识别并建议顺序；这不是自动启用 Agent Teams。它停用原 `tool-agent-team` profile entry，自己加载宿主当版的官方 Team 工具，避免双重注册。若你曾自定义官方工具的 `freshProvider` / `forkProvider`，请在本插件配置中使用相同值。
5. 开新会话，按你的发送设置使用 **Steer / 插话**。Queue / 排队仍按原语义执行；普通 Enter 的行为由 DSH 设置决定。

卸载同样建议先 idle，然后在插件管理器移除，或运行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <你的测试profile> remove dsh-team-flow-continuous
```

若主动禁用时仍有 wait，会返回 `TEAM_FLOW_RC2_DISABLED` 错误；未捕获该错误的 PTC 程序可能停止后续语句。移除 bundle 后恢复原版工具配置。请勿与另一套同名 Team 工具 owner 同时启用。

在 DSH Market 中禁用时，市场会移除本插件的整层补丁，使官方工具恢复；重新启用后再应用本插件。请使用**包级开关**或卸载：手工只将 `dsh-team-flow-continuous` loader entry 设为 disabled，会留下下层对官方工具的停用。市场可能要求重启；等所有 Agent idle 后操作。预构建包与 GitHub 源码均包含 `lib`，无需允许安装脚本；未发布 npm。

## 如何工作与兼容边界

插件加载**宿主自己的** Team 工具，不复制冻结旧版工具。注册前克隆 wait 定义，仅在缺少合法 Steer 成功值时扩展 schema / render；已经支持该值时保留契约。它还临时装饰公开 `Agent.steer()`，记录原消息 ID，再通过 `tools/execute` 的派生 signal 结束单次真实 wait，等待底层 promise 收敛。没有调用 Agent cancel，也不 claim / remove / 重发 Inbox 输入。

这些方法装饰不是官方专用扩展 hook。提前缓存旧 bound 方法、其他插件装饰同一方法、事件语义或 ABI 变化都可能影响兼容。检测到不支持的输入形状或成功 schema 时保留原等待并告警；模块 ABI 不符时可能加载失败。

**兼容目标从 0.2.0-rc.2 起持续维护，不锁死 commit 或版本上限。尚未发布版本无法提前承诺永远兼容；破坏性变化可能要求更新插件。** peer `*` 用于复用宿主，不代表所有版本已测试。“user Steer”指通过 `Agent.steer()` 投递的 user 消息，不认证任意第三方调用是否来自真人。

## 从源码复现

Node >=24，Git，pnpm。宿主 checkout 与 DSH_HOME 均在本仓库 `work/` 内；不会读取正式 DSH 会话。首次准备下载官方源码与锁定依赖，所有模型调用使用 Mock，不需要 API Key。

```powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run setup:host
npm run build
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run pack:local
npm run test:market
```

默认准备和验证 `0.2.1-rc.3`。已有相同固定 commit 的干净宿主 checkout 时，可给 typecheck 和 test 传 `-- --host-path <绝对路径>`，无需重复安装依赖。旧版矩阵统一传 `-- --host alpha1`、`-- --host alpha2` 或 `-- --host rc2` 给 setup、typecheck 和 test；原 `--alpha1` 参数继续可用。Windows GitHub Actions 持续运行这四档公开源码；旧 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的安装文件副本不会被上传，保留本地脱敏证据。

## 反馈

欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/issues) 提供 DSH / Node / OS 版本、Native 或 PTC、Steer / Queue 设置、最小步骤和脱敏日志。不要附 API Key、会话原文或认证链接。安全问题见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

MIT。独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系；不宣称这是上游已经合并的修复。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-like-markdown

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

> 让右侧栏的 Markdown 预览**就地可编辑**：文档保持渲染后的样子，点段落、点标题、点表格单元格，光标落在那里直接改字。
>
> Markdown editing in place for the DSH right Sidebar: the document keeps its rendered look, and clicking a paragraph, a heading, or a table cell puts the caret exactly there.

![Selecting a passage in the rendered document, with the Add to chat action bar above it](assets/selection-to-chat.png)

*选中一段文字 → 添加至会话；也可以直接点段落，就地编辑。*

*Select a passage to add it to the session, or click any paragraph to edit it in place.*

---

## 中文

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，让右侧栏的 Markdown 预览**就地可编辑**——文档保持渲染后的样子，点段落、点表格单元格、点标题，光标就落在那里，直接改字。

DSH 自带的预览插件在自己的 README 里就写明了这个缺口：*"Preview, not editing. The viewers provide no file editing."*，而且它没有暴露任何可以写工作区文件内容的客户端 API。所以这个插件自己补上写入通道（一个独立的 Remote 命名空间），再提供一个使用它的渲染器。

## 你能得到什么

| | |
|---|---|
| 打开 `.md` 文件 | 以 **Markdown（可编辑）** 打开，渲染效果与内置视图完全一致 |
| 编辑 | 点段落、标题、列表、代码围栏 → 就地变成可编辑：没有边框盒子，用的是文档自己的字体，屏幕上不出现 Markdown 标记 |
| 光标 | 点哪个字，光标就落在哪个字上，和普通文本编辑器一样 |
| 打字 | 改动立即拼回文档，所以「未保存」状态与自动保存都是实时的（停顿约 1.2 秒自动保存）；`Esc` 或 `⌘Enter` 关闭当前块 |
| 表格 | 表格保持渲染器自己的表格；点某一格只在**那一格**上浮出编辑面，也只回写那一格 |
| 引用到会话 | 在预览里选中一段文字，浮出的操作条可以把选中的文字**添加至会话**：作为带出处的引用插进输入框（界面语言是中文时按钮就叫「添加至会话」） |
| 新增 | **+ 新增段落** 追加一个段落并打开它 |
| 工具栏 | 只有一行：状态提示 · **B** / *I* / `</>` / 🔗 · 保存相关按钮 |
| `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` | 立即保存 |
| 原始文档 | `⌥⌘E` 在渲染视图与原始 Markdown 之间切换（也可以把渲染器下拉切到内置 **Text** 只读查看原文） |
| 文件在别处被改 | 未保存的内容**不会被覆盖**，工具栏给出 *仍然覆盖* 或 *从磁盘重新载入*；在你再次编辑前暂停自动保存 |
| 只读渲染视图 | 仍然可用：预览的渲染器下拉里可以选回内置的 **Markdown** |
| 草稿 | 每个标签页的未保存内容，在切换标签、切换渲染器、切到源码再切回来时都不丢 |
| 界面语言 | 中文 / 英文跟随界面语言（按钮、状态、提示文案），两种语言都有测试兜底 |
| 写入 | 经 `ctx.fs.writeText` 走文件系统后端：`read-only` 会话被拒绝，`workspace-write` 只能写工作区内；带上版本即 compare-and-set |
| 失败降级 | 渲染器不可用时退回纯源码编辑；单个块渲染出错时退回该块原文，不会让整个面板变空 |

## 设计

**渲染完全一致。** 正文通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MarkdownText` 渲染——就是内置 Markdown 视图用的那个组件——所以标题、列表、表格、代码块、公式、脚注（含它的链接净化策略）看起来都一样。该模块在浏览器冻结的基线模块表里，因此 `require` 它不需要任何构建步骤；万一某个部署里没有它，插件会退化成「只能编辑源码」。

**Markdown 本身就是文本，从不反推。** 编辑面是一个 `contenteditable`，它的文本内容**就是**该块的 Markdown：语法标记仍在 DOM 里、但用 CSS 隐藏，加粗、代码、链接、标题、列表符号、引用、围栏都在标记周围做样式。**任何时候都不会把样式反向序列化成语法**，所以一次编辑只可能改变字符——不存在「富文本转 Markdown」这一步把文件改花的可能。读回内容就是对文本节点做一次遍历，浏览器自己生成的块级元素算作换行。

**看起来像文档，是因为它是从文档上量出来的。** 打开一个块时，插件会读取该渲染块的计算样式（字族、字号、行高、内边距）套到编辑面上，所以进入编辑不会改变文档的字体。光标用浏览器自己的命中测试（`caretRangeFromPoint`）按你点击的坐标放置。

**选中即上下文。** 在预览里选中文字会浮出一个操作条，唯一的动作是把这段文字交给输入框自己的 `captureInsertion()` / `insertText()`——它是光标处的一次可撤销编辑，不会覆盖你已经写好的内容——并以「出处单独一行、下面是被引用的段落」的形式插入，末尾留一个空行——光标就落在那里，你可以直接接着提问。为了让拖拽始终能用于选择，「按下与松开在同一位置」才进入编辑，拖拽不会。

**表格单元格按格编辑。** 表格是一个块，为了改一格而替换整张表不叫编辑——所以表格保持渲染器自己的表格，点某一格时只在那一格上浮出一个单格编辑面。单元格文本通过它在行内的**字节区间**改写，行内其它格、分隔行、表外内容一个字节都不动。编辑面每次渲染都重新量一次该格的位置，所以行变高时它会跟着走；它是单行的：回车即提交、粘贴进来的换行会变成空格，因此一次单元格编辑**不可能**多出一行。

**是块，不是第二套文档模型。** 源码按空行切块，代码围栏保持完整。每个块记录精确的 `[start, end)` 区间，所以一次编辑只替换那段区间，其余字节——空格、列表符号、结尾换行——原样保留。块做了 memo，敲一个键只重画被改动的范围而不是整篇文档。每个块都有错误边界，渲染失败时退回原文而不是让整个面板变空。

**一个小小的 Remote 命名空间。** `markdownDocs/write` 接收 `{ sessionId, path, absolutePath, content, expectedVersion? }`，返回状态信封（`saved` / `stale` / `denied` / `missing` / `error`）。宿主半通过 `ctx.fs.writeText` 写入，所以目标身份、原子性、沙箱围栏都由文件系统后端负责：`read-only` 会话会被拒绝，`workspace-write` 只能写工作区内。传 `expectedVersion` 时写入是 compare-and-set；除非用户明确选择 *仍然覆盖*，编辑器都会带上它。

`index.js` 不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。Typert 绑定是手工拼的（`ctx.provide` 加一个冻结的 `typertRemote`），调用描述符用 `ctx.typert.register` 注册——这是生成物管线之外的宿主被文档认可的路径。避免这些 import 让插件不依赖「profile 如何解析运行时包」。`client.js` 是一个普通的 module-loader bundle，无需构建。

## 安装

这是一个 profile bundle：它声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以装上即启用。

**在 Harness 会话里** —— 让 agent 安装，它会用 `plugin_manager` 的 `action: install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录。

**在终端里** —— 先退出应用：

```sh
# macOS 应用自带的 CLI
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-codex-like-markdown
```

安装需要授权或 Full access，因为 profile bundle 会在宿主进程内执行代码。本包没有安装脚本、也没有依赖。卸载用 `remove_bundle`。

之后修改 `client.js` 会**即时生效**——客户端模块注册表在监视这个 bundle——而改动 `index.js` 需要重启应用以加载新的模块代。

## 环境要求

本插件是针对把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview` 与 API Gateway 挂进 Web 组合的 Harness 版本开发的（0.2.0-rc.2 前后）。如果某个 profile 没有它们，客户端半会保持 inactive 而不是报错：它在等 `slots`、`documentPreviews`、`remote`、`locale` 这四个服务。

## 已知限制

- **编辑过程中**现敲的 Markdown 语法会先以原文显示，直到该块被关闭——因为编辑面在持有你的光标与输入法组合态时不会重渲染。`Esc` 之后就会渲染。
- 标记被隐藏意味着它不能手工编辑；在标记旁边删字可能把标记删掉，结果是那处格式丢失（下一次渲染可见），**不会改变你的文字**。
- 表格是逐格编辑；增删整行整列属于结构性修改，请用**源码**视图。
- 块按空行切分。用空行隔开的松散列表会渲染成多个列表；被空行切断的表格也会被切开。某行格子数不再匹配表头时，表格就地结束，不会吞掉后面的正文。
- 脚注与引用式链接只在单个块内解析，不跨文件。
- 完整字节读取受预览的 `maxFileBytes`（32 MiB）限制。
- 草稿存在浏览器内存里，生命周期为当前页面；刷新页面不保留。
- 「添加至会话」依赖预览拿到输入框的 `inputActions`：没有可用的输入框时会提示「无法添加至会话」；输入框正在提交时同样会被它拒绝。
- 写入是整篇替换加可选的版本护栏。读与写之间发生的改动会被**检测到**而不是合并，谁覆盖谁由用户决定。

## 测试

先抓取测试套件依赖的运行时包，再 `npm test`；见 [test/README.md](test/README.md)。186 条断言覆盖：宿主半经过**真实 Gateway 派发与真实文件写入**、正文经过**真实 React 渲染**、以及交互逻辑——其中最关键的一条是**把编辑面的标记剥掉后必须逐字节等于原 Markdown**。

## 许可

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

---

## English

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
makes the right Sidebar's Markdown preview **editable in place** — the document
keeps its rendered look, and clicking a paragraph, a table cell, or a heading
puts the caret exactly there and lets you type into it.

The shipped preview states the gap in its own README — *"Preview, not editing.
The viewers provide no file editing."* — and no shipped client-callable API
writes workspace file content. This plugin supplies the missing write path
itself, as its own Remote namespace, and adds a renderer that uses it.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| Opening a `.md` file | Opens in **Markdown (editable)**, rendered exactly like the built-in viewer |
| Editing | Click a paragraph, heading, list, or code fence → it becomes editable in place: no border box, the document's own font, and no Markdown syntax on screen |
| Caret | Clicking lands the caret on the character you clicked, like a plain text editor |
| Typing | The edit is spliced into the document immediately, so the dirty state and auto-save stay live (auto-save after ~1.2 s idle); `Esc` or `⌘Enter` closes the block |
| Tables | The table keeps the renderer's own table; clicking a cell opens an editor over **just that cell**, and only that cell is written back |
| Quote to chat | Select a passage in the preview and the bar adds it to the composer as a quote with its source (in a Chinese UI the action reads 添加至会话) |
| Adding | **+ Add paragraph** appends a paragraph and opens it |
| Toolbar | One row: the status · **B** / *I* / `</>` / 🔗 · the saving controls |
| `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` | Saves immediately |
| Raw document | `⌥⌘E` swaps the rendered view for the raw Markdown and back (the renderer dropdown's built-in **Text** viewer reads it, read-only) |
| File changed elsewhere | The dirty buffer is **kept**, and the toolbar offers *Overwrite* or *Load from disk*; auto-save pauses until you edit again |
| Read-only rendered view | Still available: the preview's renderer dropdown lists the built-in **Markdown** viewer |
| Drafts | A tab's unsaved text survives switching tabs, switching renderers, and going to the source view and back |
| UI language | Chinese and English copy follows the interface language, with tests pinning both dictionaries |
| Writes | Through `ctx.fs.writeText`, so the filesystem backend keeps the fence: a `read-only` session is denied, `workspace-write` stays inside the workspace root, and the version makes it compare-and-set |
| Degrading | Without the renderer it falls back to source-only editing; a block that fails to render falls back to its own raw text instead of blanking the pane |

## Design

**Identical rendering.** The body renders through `MarkdownText` from
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — the very component the shipped Markdown
viewer uses — so headings, lists, tables, code blocks, math, and footnotes look
the same, including its link sanitization. That module ships in the browser's
frozen baseline module table, so requiring it adds no build step; if a deployment
ever lacks it, the plugin falls back to source-only editing.

plugins.description: 嘉立创 EDA .enet 网表原理图校对 —— DeepSeek Harness 插件（9 个 enet_* 工具 + 2 个技能）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enet-review —— 嘉立创网表原理图校对（DSH 插件）

把「解析嘉立创 EDA 导出网表（`.enet`）并校对原理图」这件事，做成 DeepSeek Harness 里
**agent 可以直接调用**的 9 个只读工具 + 2 个技能。

**纯 JS、零运行时依赖。** 不需要 Python、不需要 npm install、不需要构建步骤 ——
因为本机 `PATH` 里没有 `node`，两个 Python 解释器又各缺一半 PDF 库，
自包含是唯一可靠的做法（原始 Python 版保留在遗留工程里作为 CLI 参照）。

---

## 这个插件能发现什么

| 类别 | 例子 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| **断链** | `OAMP_6.5V` 和 `OAMP_+6.5V` 是两个不相连的网络，中间没有任何元件 | P0 |
| **FDA 反馈接反** | 全差分放大器反馈从同侧取 → 正反馈 → 一上电就饱和 | P0 |
| **电源轨孤儿** | 一条电源轨找不到源，或者只有源没有负载 | P1 |
| **网络接进不贴的器件** | 网络连到了标记为 NC 的器件 | P1 |
| **悬空脚** | `EN` / `RESET` / `MUTE` 挂在只有一个成员的网络里 | P2 |
| **引脚名与网络冲突** | 负压 LDO 的 `VIN` 接在正压网上 | P2 |
| **兄弟封装引脚序混用** | 同封装不同型号，引脚序不同 | P2 |
| **规则自身异常** | 某条规则跑挂了 → **审计不完整，不能当通过** | P3 |

### 差分对不会误报（关键设计）

丢弃非字母数字后 `DAC_OUTL+` 和 `DAC_OUTL-` 是"同名"的，但**正负号是极性语义**。
判定用「正号等价键」：

| 网络对 | 键 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| `OAMP_6.5V` / `OAMP_+6.5V` | 同为 `oamp65v` | **报断链**（实测复现旧项目） |
| `DAC_OUTL+` / `DAC_OUTL-` | `dacoutl+` / `dacoutl-` | **不报**，正常差分对 |
| `-5V` / `5V` | `-5v` / `5v` | 不报，极性真的相反，交人工判断 |

有跨接元件的相似标签降为 P3（仅命名不一致，**不是断链**）；
无跨接的才是 P0。修这个之前，差分对一次误报 7 对，报告直接失去可信度。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：一行搞定（**已实测**）

在 DSH 会话里让 agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "C:\\Users\\lishuo\\Documents\\deepseek-harness\\default-workspace\\dsh-enet-review" })
```

它会自动把两处都写好，不需要手改 profile：

| 它写什么 | 写到哪 |
|---|---|
| `"@local/dsh-enet-review": "link:C:/…/dsh-enet-review"` | profile `package.json` → `dependencies` |
| `"@local/dsh-enet-review"` | profile `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`（**追加到末尾**） |

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` **不会**被改 —— 插件行由插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`
经 bundle 机制注入。

返回里读 `application`：`applied` = 已生效；`failed` = 有插件行没激活，看 `error.diagnostic`。

> ⚠️ `install_bundle` 需要 danger-full-access 权限或当次批准（该 action 不弹交互确认，
> 策略为 `never` 时也能执行）。

#### 如果第一次装的时候源码有毛病（本插件踩过，值得记下来）

实际遇到过的顺序：

1. 第一次 `install_bundle` → `application: "failed"`，
   `error.diagnostic` = `dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate / enet-review (@local/dsh-enet-review): failed to import`。
2. 修好源码后**再跑一次 `install_bundle`** → `changed: false` + `error.code: "ambiguous-install"`，
   **它不会重新尝试导入**，`application` 仍然是 `failed`。**这一步会骗人：看起来像还没修好。**
3. 真正有效的动作是对那一行做一次 disabled → enabled 的往返（走 profile 配置热重载）：

   ```
   plugin_manager({ action: "set_plugin", target: "include:enet-review", enabled: false })
   plugin_manager({ action: "set_plugin", target: "include:enet-review", enabled: true })
   ```

   第二次返回 `application: "applied"`、`warnings: []`，**不需要重启**。

entry id 形如 `include:<patchId>`；不确定时用
`cordis_inspect_query({platform:"host", provider:"Config", method:"listConfigs", input:{name:"@local/dsh-enet-review"}})`
拿准确 id。注意该返回里的 `status` 是 **Config schema 状态**（`absent` = 插件活着但没导出
`Config`），**不是**激活状态；激活状态要去 `plugin_manager list_plugins` 看 `fiberPhase`。

#### 怎么确认真的生效了

```powershell
# 1) 插件行在不在、激活没有
plugin_manager({ action: "list_plugins" })        # 找 include:enet-review → "fiberPhase":"active"
# 2) 9 个工具 agent 到底看不看得见
cordis_inspect_query({ platform: "host", provider: "Tool", method: "listTools" })
```

### 方式 B：手动 link（不推荐，目前唯一能跑通的形态有硬约束）

`install_bundle` 内部干的就是这件事：`dependencies` 写
`"@local/dsh-enet-review": "link:<绝对路径>"`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾追加同名项。
手改 profile 是官方明确不推荐的（改坏了没有回滚），能走方式 A 就走 A。

> **硬约束**：以 `link:` 装载的插件，**不能 `import` 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包**。
> 原因：`cordis-plugin-loader` 对裸说明符走 Node 原生 `import()`，按插件目录的
> **真实路径**向上找 `node_modules`；而宿主包（`dsh-tools` / `dsh-skill` / `cordis`）
> 在 Desktop 下只存在于 `app.asar` 内，磁盘上没有
> （`profiles\desktop\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\` 里只有 `cosmokit` 和 `schemastery`）。
> 症状：`Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools' … ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，
> 整行 `failed to import`。
> 从 npm / GitHub 装进 profile 的**真包**没有这个问题 —— 所以同一个 API，
> 别人能用，本地的 link 插件不能用。
>
> 本插件的对策：自带 `lib/define-tool.js`（`defineTool` 的等价零依赖实现），
> 全包**只 import `node:*` 和相对路径**。`_selftest.mjs` 里有一组
> 「无宿主依赖（可被 link 装载）」断言，递归扫所有 `.js`/`.mjs` 的 import 说明符来守住这条底线。
> 参照实现：`@local/dsh-chat-mode` 用的是同一招 —— patch 里 `name: './policy.js'`，
> 把逻辑放在**包根**由 loader 以相对路径加载，`policy.js` 同样不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。

### 自检

```powershell
$node = 'C:\Users\lishuo\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe'
cd C:\Users\lishuo\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-enet-review
& $node _selftest.mjs
```

输出 `全部通过` 即 OK。自检覆盖：纯函数 + 坏输入 + BOOK 手册查找 + 技能发现（mock
`SkillProviderControl`）+ **工具定义（本地 `defineTool` 的参数编译与校验）** +
**无宿主依赖扫描** + 真实网表的 10 项断言（含「差分对不被误报」回归断言）。

---

## 9 个工具

所有工具**只读**：不改 `.enet`、不改工程、不写文件。
`file` 参数都可省略 —— 会从当前目录向上自动找 `*.enet`。

| 工具 | 用途 | 参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `enet_netlist` | 网表概览 / 元件清单 / 网络清单 | `file` `components` `nets` `grep` `limit` |
| `enet_audit` | 跑全部规则，按 P0→P3 返回 | `file` `severity` `detail` |
| `enet_dangling` | 单脚网络（有源器件优先） | `file` `all` |
| `enet_net` | 单个网络的成员，可顺带列"孪生网" | `net` `file` `similar` |
| `enet_part` | 单位号：每个引脚 → 网络（带推断标签） | `des` `file` |
| `enet_link` | 两个网络之间的跨接元件（判定断链用） | `net1` `net2` `file` |
| `enet_fda` | 全差分放大器反馈交叉判定 | `des` `file` |
| `enet_datasheet` | 三级降级手册查找 | `part` `supplierPart` `online` `dir` |
| `enet_pin_infer` | 引脚名推断（可结合实连网络给矛盾提示） | `pinName` `des` `pin` `file` |

### 典型用法

```
enet_netlist()                                     # 先看规模
enet_audit()                                       # 全量审计
enet_link({ net1: "OAMP_6.5V", net2: "OAMP_+6.5V" })   # 确认是否真断链
enet_part({ des: "U23" })                          # 看某颗芯片每脚连到哪
enet_datasheet({ part: "ES9038Q2M" })              # 查手册（先查本地 BOOK）
```

---

## 2 个技能

| 技能 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `enet-review` | 完整校对流程（8 步）、分级口径、判定话术、**数据手册三级查找硬性规则**、7 条陷阱 |
| `datasheet-lookup` | 数据手册查找独立技能：BOOK → 联网 → 按引脚名推断（必须标注"未核对手册"） |

### 数据手册查找优先级（硬性）

```
C:\Users\lishuo\Documents\BOOK          ← 第一级：约 248 个 PDF，归一化模糊匹配
        ↓ 找不到
联网（立创商城 / 搜索链接，只返回候选不自动下载）
        ↓ 无网络
按引脚名称推断 —— 必须标注「推断，未核对手册」，置信度上限 medium
```

**禁止**把推断写成"手册规定"。**禁止**把 `partial`/`family` 级匹配说成"已找到手册"。

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-enet-review/
  package.json            插件 manifest（dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml）
  cordis.patch.yml        insert: id=enet-review / name=@local/dsh-enet-review
  index.js                入口：inject=['tools','skills']，apply() 注册工具 + 技能 provider
  lib/
    designator.js         位号/引脚号自然排序；三种网络名规范化键
    netlist.js            parseEnet / readEnet / class Netlist（含 similarLabelPairs）
    pininfer.js           22 条引脚名推断规则
    rules.js              8 条校对规则 + audit()
    datasheet.js          BOOK 目录模糊查找（exact / partial / family 三档打分）
    datasheet-online.js   联网兜底（立创商城 GET + 搜索链接）
    frontmatter.js        SKILL.md frontmatter 解析（支持 | 和 > 块标量）
    skills.js             技能 provider（递归扫描 skills/**/SKILL.md）
    tools.js              9 个工具定义
    define-tool.js        defineTool 的零依赖等价实现（link 装载不能 import @deepseek-ai/*，见「方式 B」）
  skills/
    enet-review/SKILL.md      校对主技能
    datasheet-lookup/SKILL.md 手册查找技能
  references/
    enet-format.md        .enet 的 JSON 结构与字段语义
    audit-playbook.md     完整流程与判定话术对照表
    case-notes.md         真实案例（CH32V305 音频板）—— 仅案例，非通用规则
  _selftest.mjs           自检（不依赖 DSH 宿主）
  tools/dump.mjs          开发诊断脚本
```

---

## 参考实现来源

- 工具注册：`dsh-meme` 的 `defineTool` 用法；`lib/define-tool.js` 按其宿主实现
  （`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:838-887` 的 `defineTool` + `:792-811` 的
  `parameterSchemaSpecToJsonSchema` / `valueSchemaSpecToJsonSchema`）等价重写
- 技能 provider：`@dhicoc/dsh-reverse-skill`（`resolveBundledRoot` + `collect` + `createProvider`）
  与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-badge`（53 行最小范例）
- 遗留 CLI 参照：`C:\Users\lishuo\XiaomiMiMoProjects\原理图校对\scripts\enet.py`

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dialog-improve

DSH Web GUI 插件开发工作区。**仓库根即工作区**，插件本体位于子目录。

A workspace for developing DSH Web GUI plugins. **The repository root is the workspace**; the plugin itself lives in a subdirectory.

## 包含什么 / What's inside

| 路径 Path | 说明 Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`plugins/dsh-movable-settings/`](plugins/dsh-movable-settings/) | 插件本体：让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动 / 可缩放 / 可最大化（已在 npm 发布） |
| `.dsh-graph/` | 本工作区的目标看板数据，由 dsh-graph 插件管理，**不入 git** |

## 插件：dsh-movable-settings

把 DSH Web GUI 内置的「设置」弹窗从固定居中、不可调整，变成**可拖动、可八向缩放、可双击最大化**，并记住上次位置与尺寸的浮层。

Turns the built-in DSH **Settings** dialog into a movable, resizable, maximizable floating window that remembers its geometry.

- 详细说明 / Full docs： [`plugins/dsh-movable-settings/README.md`](plugins/dsh-movable-settings/README.md)
- npm： [dsh-movable-settings](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-movable-settings)
- 安装 / Install（在 DSH 会话里 / inside a DSH session）：

  ```
  plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-movable-settings
  ```

  也可以直接对会话里的 Agent 说「帮我安装 dsh-movable-settings 插件」；
  或用 CLI 装包：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-movable-settings`（CLI 只把包装进 profile，之后需在「设置 → 插件」里启用）。

  Or just ask the agent in a session to install it; with the CLI, run
  `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-movable-settings` (package only — enable it under
  Settings → Plugins afterwards). Then refresh the page.

## 开发 / Development

```bash

npm run check   # 语法检查 / syntax check
npm test        # 49 项断言 / 49 assertions (node:test)
```

After editing the client half, **refresh the page** (unless the `pnpm run dev:web` HMR watcher is running).

plugins.readme_text:
# @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

**English** | [中文](#中文)

> Edit the user-global instructions file (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`) from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings UI — no need to open the `.dsh` folder by hand.

> Based on [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt) (MIT, © couplingartist); this repository fixes its packaging so the plugin actually installs, and continues the work.

![Settings page](assets/global-prompt-settings-page.png)

## What you get

| Situation | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Settings → **全局指令** (Global instructions) | A new settings section: multiline editor + Save button + file path + character count |
| First save | Creates `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` if it does not exist (UTF-8, no BOM) |
| Single source of truth | The settings page reads/writes the same file external editors do — no second copy |
| Effect timing | Follows the harness's touch-driven reload: new sessions read the latest content immediately; open sessions re-read on their next successful file tool call or turn |
| Security | The HTTP API answers loopback (127.0.0.1) only; request bodies capped at 1 MiB |

## What this fork fixes

As published, upstream could never be installed from GitHub or npm:

| Defect (upstream) | Fix (here) |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` gitignored, no `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` installs an empty shell (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) | Prebuilt `lib/` is committed, and `prepack` rebuilds before `npm publish` |
| The npm name `dsh-global-prompt` belongs to an unrelated project | Published as `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| Peers pinned to `0.1.1-rc.2` → dsh 0.2.x rejects the install | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` ranges `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` + `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` lists modules that no longer exist in the shell | Now lists `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (verified against the 0.2.0-rc.2 frozen module table) |
| Client bundle id hardcoded to the old name; source map leaks local paths | Registers under the full package id; source maps disabled |
| No LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | Added (MIT) |

## Install

```powershell
# npm (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

# or straight from GitHub (works because lib/ is committed)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

Restart the web instance so the new plugin loads:

```powershell
dsh web
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → Settings → **全局指令**. (Adjust `--profile web` to the profile you actually run.)

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

## Development

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest: store (13) + editor (7)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (client bundle)
```

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | Seam 1: read/write semantics of the user-global instructions file (unit-tested) |
| `src/index.ts` | Host plugin: registers `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | Seam 2: the editor component (unit-tested) |
| `src/client/api.ts` | HTTP implementation of the editor IO boundary |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client plugin: registers the `settings.section` entry |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | Build: ESM host lib + CJS client factory wrapped in `__ModuleLoader__.load` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle layer: inserts the `global-prompt` row |

## License & credits

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Original work by **couplingartist** ([dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)); packaging, compatibility and maintenance fixes by **HelloQingTao**.

---

# 中文

**[English](#zfgctadsh-global-prompt)** | 中文

> 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置界面里直接编辑**用户全局指令文件**（`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`），不必再手动打开 `.dsh` 目录改文件。

> 基于 [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)（MIT，© couplingartist）；本仓库修复了它的打包问题使其真正可安装，并继续维护。

![设置页](assets/global-prompt-settings-page.png)

## 你会得到什么

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 设置 → **全局指令** | 新增一个设置分区页：多行编辑器 + 保存按钮 + 文件路径显示 + 字符数统计 |
| 首次保存 | 文件不存在时自动创建 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（UTF-8 无 BOM） |
| 唯一真源 | 设置页与外部编辑器读写同一份文件，没有第二份数据 |
| 生效时机 | 遵循系统触摸驱动刷新：新会话立即读到最新内容；已打开会话在下一次成功文件工具调用或新一轮时重新读取 |
| 安全 | HTTP 接口仅允许本机回环（127.0.0.1）访问；请求体上限 1 MiB |

## 本仓库修复了什么

上游原版按它发布的样子在 GitHub / npm 上根本装不上：

| 缺陷（上游） | 修复（本仓库） |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` 被 gitignore 且没有 `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` 装出来是空壳（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`） | 预构建的 `lib/` 直接入库，并在 `npm publish` 前用 `prepack` 重新构建 |
| npm 上的 `dsh-global-prompt` 包名属于另一个无关项目 | 改名发布为 `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| peer 钉死 `0.1.1-rc.2` → 被 dsh 0.2.x 拒装 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 改为范围 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，并声明 `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` 引用了外壳里已不存在的模块 | 改为 0.2.0-rc.2 冻结模块表实际存在的 `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` |
| 客户端 bundle id 硬编码旧名；sourcemap 泄漏本地路径 | 按完整包名注册；关闭 sourcemap |
| 缺 LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | 已补齐（MIT） |

## 安装

```powershell
# npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

# 或者直接从 GitHub 安装（lib/ 已入库，开箱即用）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

重启 web 实例使新插件生效：

```powershell
dsh web
```

然后打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → 设置 → **全局指令**。（`--profile web` 请换成你实际使用的 profile。）

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

## 开发

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest：store（13）+ editor（7）
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js（宿主半）+ lib/client.js（客户端 bundle）
```

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | 接缝 1：用户全局指令文件的读写语义（单测覆盖） |
| `src/index.ts` | Host 插件：注册 `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | 接缝 2：编辑器组件（单测覆盖） |
| `src/client/api.ts` | 编辑器 IO 边界的 HTTP 实现 |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client 插件：注册 `settings.section` 分区 |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | 构建：ESM 宿主 lib + 包在 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 里的 CJS 客户端工厂 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：插入 `global-prompt` 行 |

## 许可与致谢

MIT — 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。原作者 **couplingartist**（[dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)）；打包、兼容性与维护修复来自 **HelloQingTao**。

plugins.description: Hermetic composition lock for DeepSeek Harness — profile fingerprint; drifted compositions warn or fail (strict)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-freeze

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Hermetic composition lock for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

**"Today's agent composition is byte-identical to the one you reviewed."**
Fingerprints the booted profile — installed dependencies (name-sorted), the
ordered bundle composition, the pnpm lockfile hash, the user patch layer —
baselines it, and compares on every boot. A session running on a drifted
composition says so loudly; `strict: true` fails the boot entirely (the
`--frozen` posture for CI). Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

Family: ... mcp-test (what agents can call) · prompt-drift (what they are
told) · **freeze (what exactly they are running)**.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

The supply-chain lane has seven install-time scanners and one read-only
plugin ledger (`dsh-harbor`) — all answer "is this package ok to install?"
Nobody answers **"is the composition I'm running today the one that was
audited?"** Spike-verified: `dsh --dump-config` is byte-stable across runs,
and profile files (package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / cordis.patch.yml) are the
complete composition truth — a deterministic fingerprint is sound.

## What moves the alarm

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `dependencies` | a package was added/removed/retargeted |
| `bundles` | the ordered composition changed |
| `pnpm-lock` | resolved versions moved (upgrade!) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the user layer changed |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-freeze
  name: dsh-freeze
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-freeze/baseline.json
    strict: false          # true: drift fails the boot (CI posture)
    profile: ""            # '' auto-detects from argv (--profile, else 'web')
```

Note: the baseline is written into the *working directory* of the session by
default; for CI, point it somewhere durable and commit it.

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-freeze] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-freeze` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party profile pinning (`--frozen` boot flag or
equivalent), this freezes at its last working version with a postmortem
here.

plugins.description: DSH skill manager plugin: /skills, /skills-uninstall, /skills-update, /skills-doctor
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that gives you both a **visual Skills
panel** and a **command-line skill manager**:

- **Settings → Skills panel** — browse every installed skill (name · invocation · source · path), with search
- **`/skills`** — list skills (name · invocation · source repo), optionally filtered
- **`/skills-uninstall <名字>`** — remove an installed skill
- **`/skills-update [仓库名]`** — pull a repo mirror and re-sync its links (default `mattpocock-skills`)
- **`/skills-doctor`** — health check: dead links, invalid frontmatter, orphaned mirrors

## Why

DSH skills (`SKILL.md` bundles discovered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`)
ship no UI. This plugin closes the gap twice: a read-only Settings panel
(client half) for browsing, and `/` commands (host half) for reading and
writing. The write commands operate on the symlink layout in `~/.dsh/skills`
(`git pull` + reconcile), after which DSH's watcher hot-reloads the result.

## Install

From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-skill-console
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-skill-console-1.0.0.tgz
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

## Usage

```
/skills                    # list every skill in this session
/skills docx               # filter by keyword (name, description, whenToUse)
/skills-uninstall pr       # remove the `pr` skill
/skills-update             # update mattpocock-skills (default)
/skills-update my-repo     # update another repo mirror
/skills-doctor             # structural health check
```

The panel lives in the **main sidebar** (the Skills icon, next to Plugins) and
also under **Settings → Skills**. It is a search-centric management console: a
large centred search bar over a full-width card gallery, with the filters
(source / invocation / sort) tucked into a slide-out panel behind the **筛选**
button. Click a card for a slide-over detail drawer with the description,
invocation, source, path, a button that copies its `/name` command, and an
**uninstall** button. The header **installs** skills from a git URL or local path
(preview → select → link), **updates** the mattpocock-skills mirror, and runs a
**health check**. The same actions also exist as `/skills-uninstall`,
`/skills-update` and `/skills-doctor`.

Each `/skills` line reads `- /name [invocation · 来源:repo] — description`:

- **invocation** — `模型+用户` / `仅模型` / `仅用户` / `未开放`
- **来源** — the repo mirror a symlink resolves into (e.g. `mattpocock-skills`),
  or a discovery-root label for non-repo skills (`内置`, `DSH用户`, `项目`, …).

## Configuration

Override the managed directories on the `skill-console` row in your profile
patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) if needed:

```yaml
- id: skill-console
  config:
    skillsDir: /Users/you/.dsh/skills            # default
    reposDir: /Users/you/.dsh/repos              # default
```

## Distribution

The primary channel is this GitHub repository (install via the git URL above).
Publishing to npm is optional; if you do, the scoped name requires `--access
public`:

```sh
npm login
npm publish --access public
```

The loader's gate is the plugin's **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges**, compared
against the running DSH version (semver, with prereleases included) — a peer
pinned to one exact release (`0.2.0-rc.2`) turns the plugin "incompatible" the
moment the app moves to `0.2.1-rc.2`. Keep those ranges as `^0.2.0-rc.2`, and
extend `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` (the market's compatibility table) when a
new DSH release has been verified.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: four commands + the panel's `/api/skill-console/list` route |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half: the Settings "Skills" panel (React) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that mounts the package as one host row |
| `package.json` | npm metadata + `dsh.bundle`/`dsh.client`/`dsh.compatibility` |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Offline test of `/skills` against fake services |
| `test/manager.test.mjs` | Filesystem commands against a throwaway git remote |

## Test

```sh
node test/smoke.mjs
node test/manager.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: DSH output style plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-style · Codex style

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

An independent, optional DeepSeek Harness output-style plugin targeting desktop **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2**. It does not modify DSH, Butler, or Aqua source code, and starts no service or resident process.

`engines.dsh` and the optional peer `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` both declare exactly `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2`. The optional peer describes the host without installing another DSH runtime; it does not claim support for later prereleases. Recheck Client Slots and the `systemPrompt` service after upgrading DSH; local tests do not replace live App acceptance.

## Features and boundaries

- **Answer wording:** conclusions first, concise delivery, real verification, and explicit disclosure of checks not run. The prompt is a presentation preference, not a change to tools, permissions, or execution rules; identical behavior across all models is not guaranteed.
- **Progress display:** reuses native work-step grouping and collapsing, with elapsed time derived from original `turn/start` / `turn/end` timestamps. Failed and stopped turns cannot be collapsed as a whole. DSH still renders final answers, approvals, errors, and attachments.
- **File changes:** fully preserves DSH's native change cards, expanded lists, and Diff interactions. It registers no turn-tail card, hides no native cards, fetches or caches no separate change data, and adds no undo feature.
- **Theme compatibility:** adjusts only chat answer text and its own progress headings; it does not override Aqua layout, glass effects, or theme tokens.

## Install and build

```sh
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
```

The package and repository are named `dsh-codex-style`, with repository metadata `https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-codex-style` and local directory `<workspace>/MySpace/dsh-plugins/dsh-codex-style`. Cordis component IDs `codex-style` / `codex-style-prompt`, settings component IDs, existing browser preference keys, and the prompt section ID remain unchanged. The client loader and style ownership use the new package name.

The npm allowlist includes the patch, Host/prompt entry points, built client, and English/Chinese READMEs; it excludes tests, dependency directories, browser snapshots, and logs. Source retains the MySpace root repository's Zlib license; see `LICENSE` for a copy. Dependencies retain their respective licenses.

Add this directory's absolute path in the **desktop profile** plugin manager, or install the local directory through the Agent's `plugin_manager`. Build artifacts live in the ignored `lib/` directory, so build before installing. The current setup uses a local link installation; do not move the source directory arbitrarily.

Refresh the current DSH window after installation or updates. This standalone plugin has no development watcher: rebuild and refresh after changing client source; refresh-free updates are not promised. There is no need to start another Web server.

Under **Settings → General settings**, the recommended setting for “Work-step display” and “Performance and usage” is “Compact”. The plugin does not override these host preferences; you can switch back to detailed display at any time. Persisted desktop preferences may take precedence over profile defaults.

## Disabling and scope

- **Disable only the UI:** Settings → General settings → **Codex 风格** (Codex style). This immediately removes the plugin's CSS and progress headings and restores native rendering; native file-change cards are always preserved. The switch is stored per browser origin and does not change the model prompt or native work-step preferences.
- **Disable only wording preferences:** disable `codex-style-prompt` (module `dsh-codex-style/prompt`) in plugin management.
- **Disable everything:** disable the entire `dsh-codex-style` bundle in plugin management.

By default the prompt is added globally to the current profile, and the UI applies to that profile's sessions. No Agent presets are created or changed, and the default model is unchanged. To apply wording preferences to only one preset, disable the global `codex-style-prompt` and declare `dsh-codex-style/prompt` in that preset's `plugins`. The UI switch is not a preset switch.

## Style lifecycle and verification

DSH's Client module loader attributes unmarked `style` tags to the module materialized next and removes them when that module unloads. This is not a shared general-purpose style layer: this plugin writes `data-plugin` and `data-plugin-css` **before** inserting its styles into the DOM, and removes only its own style tags. Progress arrows declare both SVG dimensions and inline dimensions to prevent unbounded enlargement when CSS is missing.

Each `npm test` first rebuilds the real client bundle, then verifies: no registration or hiding of native change cards; style ownership before insertion; no accidental deletion when simulating another module claiming/unloading styles; repeated toggling and unload lifecycle; error/stop boundaries; real timing; and bounded SVGs.

A previous session in the existing host at `http://127.0.0.1:19387` verified zero custom-drawn cards, visible native cards retaining all 24 records when expanded, and native file buttons opening the sidebar Diff. After simulating the loader claiming/unloading other styles, this plugin still owned its styles, with zero console or Slot errors. This is a historical acceptance record, not a claim that the current installation has been revalidated.

Real-browser acceptance and Happy DOM component tests are reported separately. The first browser check of the historical custom-card implementation did not cover later loading/unloading of other plugins and could not establish long-term style reliability; that implementation has been removed. DSH owns native change-card data scope, lifetime, and Diff behavior; this plugin does not reinterpret or rebuild them.

## Layout

- `src/prompt.mjs`: independently removable wording preferences.
- `src/host.mjs`: empty Host entry for client discovery.
- `src/client.jsx`: progress headings, settings switch, and style lifecycle.
- `src/model.mjs`: actual elapsed time and progress state.
- `src/style.css`: scoped CSS for answer text and progress headings.

Compatibility is pinned to the DSH version above. After upgrading DSH, read its actual Slot and service contracts and repeat acceptance checks; do not force execution through a version exemption.
