# dsh-frp

DeepSeek Harness plugin for **frps** (server) and **frpc** (client).

## Safety

- If `/etc/frp/frps.toml` already exists, `frp.install_server` **adopts** it and does **not** rewrite token or port ranges.
- Client configs live in `~/.config/dsh-frp/` with proxy names prefixed `dsh-frp-`, so other tunnels are untouched.
- Secrets come from environment / `~/.env` (`FRP_TOKEN`, dashboard password). Never committed.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-frp
# or
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tingaidehua/dsh-frp
```

Tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2`.

## Vendor binaries

`vendor/linux/amd64/{frps,frpc}` and `vendor/windows/amd64/{frps.exe,frpc.exe}` (frp 0.71.0).

plugins.description: Tencent Meeting plugin for DeepSeek Harness with user-supplied local credentials and explicit approval.
plugins.readme_text:
# 腾讯会议 DSH 插件

标准 Cordis Host 插件/DSH bundle，Node.js 原生实现，无 Python、无安装脚本。不附带任何账号或 Token，不读取原 skill 目录或其 `.env`。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting.git
```

亦可在 DSH 插件页输入本地绝对路径安装。发布后可将路径替换为实际 npm 包名或 Git 仓库地址。当前仅声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1，其他版本需要另行测试，勿绕过兼容性限制。

## 用户手动输入 Token

1. 用户自行访问 https://meeting.tencent.com/ai-skill 获取个人 Token。
2. 打开 DSH 插件设置中的 **腾讯会议**，在 `tokenRef` 对应的凭据输入控件中输入自己的 Token。默认凭据名称为 `DSH_TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN`。
3. `tokenRef` 配置保存的是引用名称，不是 Token。Token 保存在 DSH 本地凭据服务管理的存储中，不进入插件包、配置补丁或工具参数。
4. 凭据 UI 若在当前版本不可用，可自行设置同名启动环境变量后重启 DSH。不应把 Token 发到聊天。

插件不会自动迁移 `TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN` 或旧 skill 的 `.env`；使用独立的新引用防止误用旧凭据。没有 Token 仍可安装并查看配置状态；首次真正查询才需要鉴权。

## 使用

加载 `tencent-meeting` skill；调用 `tencent_meeting_discover` 列出动作，传 action 获取官方 inputSchema；`tencent_meeting_call` 执行准确 action 和 arguments。`statusOnly: true` 只返回凭据是否配置，不联网，不返回值。

工具参数按需加载，避免每个模型请求都带上几十个完整远端 schema。官方 schema 由服务端负责参数校验，插件额外检查关键批量限制。HTTP POST 格式沿用原 skill 的官方 JSON-RPC 接口，不假装完成了 Streamable HTTP 协议协商。

## 安全

- 请求只能发往代码内固定的腾讯会议官方 HTTPS 地址，禁止重定向；无自定义 endpoint。
- 每次操作通过 DSH 凭据服务重新读取凭据，不缓存、不输出、不写日志。
- 返回中 Token、授权、密码字段以及当前 Token 明文会脱敏。
- 写入、通讯录及未知操作必须通过 DSH approval；`never` 策略下拒绝，不发送业务请求。确认摘要不得含个人电话、邮箱、内部 ID、Token。
- 录制申请的 prepare/commit、参与者校验及通讯录意图等多步业务约束在 skill 中明确要求；插件并未通过持久状态机器证明模型已执行这些前置步骤。通讯录 meetingIntent 是模型声明，不是意图鉴别器。
- 不自动反馈、更新或重试；网络错误不打印请求头。响应最多 4 MiB、超时最多 120 秒。
- 工具结果可能包含私人会议内容并进入当前会话历史；请保护 DSH 本地数据。

## 开发与发布

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
npm pack
```

包文件白名单排除 `.env`、测试、缓存、node_modules。图标为本项目原创通用摄像机图形，不是腾讯商标。插件实现及说明重新编写；未复制官方 skill 源码或参考文件。依赖采用 DSH 已提供的 peer package，无 build scripts。

公开源码仓库：https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting 。尚未发布到 npm；dsh.so 市场收录状态以平台审核结果为准。真实腾讯接口仅在用户手动配置 Token 后验证；自动测试只使用模拟响应，不读取用户秘密。

plugins.description: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: a composer dropdown plus a default-mode setting for new sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plan-build-mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Plan / Build** mode switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), shaped like opencode's Build/Plan selector.

Two things it adds:

1. **A dropdown in the composer**, sitting immediately to the right of the permission control (`完全权限` / `Full access`). It is always visible and switches the **current** session both ways.
2. **A "Default mode" row in Settings → General**, directly under the permission row. It decides which mode **newly created** sessions start in.

## Why it exists

DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 already ships Plan mode (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode`), but the official composer chip `PlanChip` is **exit-only**:

```js
if (!(plan.pending ? !plan.active : plan.active)) return null;
```

When the session is not in Plan mode the chip renders nothing at all, so **the only way into Plan mode is typing `/plan` by hand** — there is no discoverable entry point. This plugin takes the same seat (`conversation.input.plan`) and supplies a two-way dropdown instead.

## Features

- **Always-visible dropdown** showing the current mode (`Build` or `Plan`) with a chevron.
- **Two menu items with a check mark**:
  - **Build** — implement directly (`/plan off`)
  - **Plan** — plan only, no changes executed (`/plan`)
- **Blue highlight** while in Plan mode (uses the official `--dsw-alias-state-business-*` tokens).
- **Optimistic display** — while a switch is in flight (`pending`), the button already shows the target mode.
- **Default mode row** — pick `Build` / `Plan` as the starting mode for new sessions. The current session is unaffected; use the composer control for that.

## Install

Pin the version, so pnpm's release cooldown cannot hand you an older build:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plan-build-mode@1.1.0
```

Straight from GitHub (no npm publish needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Desktop app: install from the in-app **Plugins** page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`.

Then **fully quit and restart** the process serving the profile. The client bundle revision is derived from file metadata (`mtime`/`ctime`/`size`), so a page refresh alone is not enough — a stale revision makes the browser request a URL the server now 404s, which surfaces as `client-modules: bundle script ... failed to load`.

## Use

**Composer dropdown** — click it, pick `Build` or `Plan`. It maps to the shipped `/plan` and `/plan off` commands, so nothing about the plan-mode machinery changes.

**Default mode** — Settings → General → *Default mode*, under the permission row.

> **Note**: the first time you save this row, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` gains a top-level entry at the end:
>
> ```yaml
> - id: plan-build-mode
>   name: dsh-plan-build-mode
>   config:
>     defaultMode: plan
>   ```
>
> That is the normal `config-editor` write path. Delete the entry (or set `build`) to go back to the default.

## How it works

| Concern | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Composer seat | `conversation.input.plan` — the `modes` row of the input bar, adjacent to `conversation.input.permission` |
| Shadowing the official chip | `register({ priority: -1 })` — a `single` slot only rejects *equal* priority; the lowest priority renders |
| Reading state | `useProjection("plan")` → `{ active, pending }` |
| Switching | `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, "/plan" \| "/plan off", [])` |
| Styles | deduplicated injection via `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-plan-build-mode"]`, reusing official size/colour tokens |
| Settings row seat | `settings.general.item` list slot, `id: "default-mode"`, `order: -10` (permission is `-20`, language is `0`) |
| Settings read/write | `ctx.configForms.get("plan-build-mode")` → `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:"set",path:["defaultMode"],value}], revision)` |
| Config field | `z.union([z.const("build"), z.const("plan")]).default("build").volatile()` — only entries carrying volatile fields reach the settings surface |
| Suppressing the auto form | `ctx.inject(["settings"], (child) => child.effect(() => child.settings.configure({ auto: false }, ctx.fiber)))` |
| Pinning new sessions | On `session/created`, if the session is brand new (`seq === 0`, not seeded, no `parentSession`) and the default is `plan`, append `plan/mode` `{ active: true }` — the same first-party event `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode` writes, and one of the names on the persisted event allowlist |

### What "Plan mode" actually is

Plan mode is a **soft, prompt-level** guide, not a sandbox. All tools stay available in both modes; the harness injects a `plan:policy` prompt section that tells the model to explore and plan rather than execute. Real restriction comes from the **permission presets** (sandbox mode + approval policy), which are independent and read no plan state. If you want a hard read-only guarantee, switch the permission preset to Read Only.

Switching mid-turn is supported: the intent is queued and applied at the next turn boundary, while the button immediately reflects the target.

## Compatibility

| dsh | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | Verified on Windows, web profile — dropdown, settings row, persistence, and new-session pinning all exercised |

Declared range: `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`. The plugin targets the 0.2.x seat layout (`conversation.input.plan`, `settings.general.item`) and the `plan/mode` event, so older 0.1.x hosts are out of scope.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Restart afterwards. The official `PlanChip` returns to its original behaviour immediately — **this plugin modifies no official file**.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: An unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot with live token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the sidebar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cursor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble reports the current
session's real token usage.

![whale-girl](assets/whale-girl-768.webp)

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> [Source & attribution](#source--attribution). Chinese docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What she does

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her face (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floating companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:position']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the window shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°) and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and hold ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold away. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4 fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mood` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦 in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers from DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" line 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occupancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session — the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields when the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separate layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Install

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so installing it mounts both halves —
no profile editing, no manual copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Turanbuturan/dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

`--profile desktop` is the DSH desktop app; use `--profile web` for a plain web
profile. A release tarball or a local checkout works the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

Reload the page afterwards. Host-side changes need a full app restart (Node's ESM
cache pins the module path), but this plugin's host half is empty — a page
refresh is enough.

### Manual drop-in

Copy the folder into `<profile>/plugins/` and add the row to the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-girl
      name: "./plugins/dsh-agent-whale-girl/index.js"
```

The path resolves against the profile directory. Removing the `insert` row (and
refreshing) removes her; the folder may stay in place.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

If you used the manual drop-in instead, delete the `insert` row and refresh.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild after changing the art or the skeleton:

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/client.css from the PNGs and layers.json
node verify-bundle.cjs lib/client.js
```

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer geometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves the bundle relative to the working
directory.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mount the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesheet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inlines the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes, rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Self-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |
| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |

## Source & attribution

The code is MIT. The character art is community fan art and keeps the terms of
the repositories it came from:

- [`Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan`](https://github.com/Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan) — MIT — **the art used now**; cut into layers and background-removed here.
- [`TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl`](https://github.com/TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl) — MIT — the earlier chibi avatar (`assets/whale-girl-avatar-512.png`).
- [`fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon`](https://github.com/fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon) — custom terms — reviewed as a candidate icon source, not shipped.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the file-by-file mapping. "DeepSeek" and the DeepSeek
whale logo belong to their respective owners; this plugin is an unofficial
community project.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-en2zh — 模型输出英译中（沉浸式翻译）

把 DSH Web 会话里**模型输出的纯英文内容**（assistant 正文 + 思考/reasoning 块）
自动翻译成中文：**译文在上、原文保留在旁**（弱化为灰色小字）；思考块折叠摘要行
也整体替换为中文（展开后译文 + 原文并列）。

## 翻译范围与跳过规则

| 处理 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| ✅ 翻译 | `assistant-step` 下的 p / li / h1-h6 / blockquote；think 块的 thinkBody 与摘要行 |
| ⛔ 跳过 | 含中文/日文/韩文（中英混杂）、代码块（pre/code）、表格、路径/URL/标识符密集文本、少于 3 个单词的短文本、流式生成中的内容、用户消息、工具卡片 |

- 纯英文判定：无 CJK 字符 + 字母占比 ≥55% + 技术词（含 `/ \ _ : = 扩展名` 等）占比 ≤30%。
- 稳定性双检：文本连续两轮扫描（约 1.5s）指纹不变才送翻，防流式半途文本。
- 译文缓存：sha256 → 中文，落盘 `~/.dsh/en2zh/cache.jsonl`，刷新页面/重复文本零成本秒回。

## 架构

- **host**（`src/host.mjs`，纯 JS 零编译）：`/en2zh/api/{ping,translate}` 路由
  （loopback/trustedHosts 信任围栏，与 side-chat 同源实现）；批量翻译
  （≤5 段/次，`<<#n>>` 分隔协议，解析缺失自动单条回退）；长文本按段落切块（≤3000 字符）。
  模型路由：`agentDefaultModel` 默认选择 → 最近一次主模型调用（`llm/stream` 捕获）→ 第一个可用 provider。
- **client**（`src/client/index.ts` → tsdown → `lib/client.js`）：MutationObserver + 周期扫描，
  状态机（watch/queued/sent/done/skip/failed，失败 30s 冷却重试 ≤3 次），
  译文块插原文旁、React 重渲染自动清理配对节点；右下角「译中 ✓/✗」悬浮开关
  （localStorage 记忆，关闭时全部还原原文显示）。

## 构建 / 注入

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh   # host 直拷 + 借用生态 tsdown 打 client（本机无 dsh 源码 checkout）
# 对 AI 说：dev_inject_plugin {"dir": "<this-plugin-dir>"}
# 改代码后：bash scripts/build.sh && dev_reload_package {"packageName": "dsh-en2zh"}
```

注入后**浏览器刷新一次页面**，client 模块才会加载。

## 调试

- host 日志：`~/.dsh/super-injector/dsh-en2zh.log`
- 路由自检：`curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/en2zh/api/ping -d '{}' -H 'content-type: application/json'`
- 手工翻译：`curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/en2zh/api/translate -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"items":[{"id":"t1","text":"Hello world, this is a test."}]}'`

plugins.description: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）
plugins.readme_text:
# 探究模式 · Inquiry Mode

简体中文 · [English](README.en.md)

一个 DSH 模式预设：把"有变量可调、有结果可看"的概念，变成一个学习者**亲手操作**的任务。

![探究模式实测：先要一个可证伪的预测，答完才给带滑块的曲线，再让他自己读数](docs/demo.png)

上图是一次真实会话的完整一轮：模型先用普通文字要了**两个可证伪的预测**（"每次动手之前都得先押注，
而且要说出来，心里猜不算"），学习者答完才拿到那张带滑块的实时曲线——整张图只有一个可动的量。
图下的数值表不是装饰：图表渲染失败时它是保底项。

**任务单位是单个交互任务，不是一门课。** 不建课程树、不排进度、不做题库。它是你在某个概念上"想亲手摸一下"时切进去的模式。

---

## 它和已有的东西有什么不同

| | 常见做法 | 探究模式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 产物 | 讲解 + 题目 | **一个可以拖的东西** + 一个必须回答的预测 |
| 学习机制 | 看讲解 → 做题 → 判分 | 预测 → 操作 → 观察 → **对质** → 自己说出规律 |
| 结束条件 | 答对 | **他用自己的话说出这个关系** |
| 判分 | LLM 或规则判分 | **不判分**——观察结果是事实，"算不算懂"由他说 |

市场上做"学习模式"的产品几乎都收敛到 **讲解 + 客观题 + 间隔重复**。本预设的差异化在**形态 A：亲手拖出直觉**（下面第 2 节），而不是再做一个刷题器。

---

## 安装

```bash
# 1) 装围栏渲染器（可选，但强烈建议——没有它就拖不动图）
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui

# 2) 装本插件
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GrowingPPP/dsh-inquiry-preset
```

把 `web` 换成你实际在用的 profile（桌面端是 `desktop`；不确定就跑 `ls ~/.dsh/profiles`）。

装好后**新建会话**，在模式列表里选 **探究模式**。如果列表里没有它，重启一次 DSH 宿主再看——
插件行的变动有时要重启才进运行中的实例。

### 关于渲染器

它**不是硬依赖**。没有渲染器时 `dsh-ui` 围栏退回普通代码块，任务按 SKILL.md 里写好的降级路径
继续成立（改问数值、列选项、手工算）。

但**形态 A（带参数滑块、拖动即时重绘的函数图）是本产品的旗舰做法**，没有渲染器就用不了。
所以你至少该装一个——任何支持 `dsh-ui` 围栏的渲染插件都行，上面那个是实测过可用的。

**本地开发**：改从仓库目录装 bundle（`plugin_manager install_bundle`，`target` 传本仓库根的绝对路径），
这样改动能直接反映到会话里；换成 `github:` 安装则固定在某个 commit。

---

## 权限与兼容性

**这个预设挂了什么、没挂什么**（都可在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里核对）：

| | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 注册的工具 | `skill`（按需加载技能）、`web_search`（联网搜索） |
| **不注册** | 任何 shell、文件读写、子代理、自动化工具 |
| **也不注册** | `web_fetch`（配置里 `fetch: false`，只搜不抓网页） |

也就是说：**装它不会给你的会话开任何新的执行面。** 它改的是"教学行为"，
不是"能做什么"——预设内的工具面比标准模式**更窄**。

**外部服务**：只有 `web_search` 会出去，且发往你自己配置的搜索服务。除此之外不访问任何外部端点。
除非你主动切到别的模式，否则它不会碰你的文件、不会跑命令。

**兼容性**：

- **DSH**：在 **`0.2.1-alpha.2` 和 `0.2.0-rc.2`（官方 `latest`）两个版本上都实测通过**。
  依赖的都是官方包
  （`dsh-persona` / `dsh-skill-filesystem` / `dsh-tool-skill` / `dsh-tool-web` / `dsh-compaction-*`），
  不依赖任何社区插件。

  两个版本之间**逐项比对过我们用到的全部配置面**：`agent-preset` 的 Config 字段、
  `persona.prefix`、`skill-filesystem.customSkillDirs`、`tool-web.fetch`、三个压缩包的 Config、
  以及 `!!js` 求值器（`with (ctx) { return eval(expr) }`）——六项全部同形。

  在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上做了**完整一份隔离安装**：组装树正确、启动**零告警**、技能发现探针全通过，
  并跑了一轮**真实会话**（模型先要一个可证伪的预测并要求说出推理，然后才给带滑块与虚线参照的曲线图）。

  注：官方 `latest` 是 `0.2.0-rc.2`，而 `0.2.1-alpha.*` 是**更新的一条 alpha 线**，
  两条线的代码并不相同——上面两个都是实测过的。
- **平台**：只在 **macOS + Web profile** 上实测过。其他平台未验证（预设本身是声明式的，理论上可移植）。
- **渲染**：旗舰形态需要一个支持 `dsh-ui` 围栏的渲染插件；没有则降级为纯文字任务。见上一节。
- **已知限制**：
  - 预设的显示名与技能正文是中文
  - 图表组件**可能渲染空白**（实测踩到过两次），所以形态 B 强制配数值表兜底
  - `plot` 的表达式语法很窄：自变量只能叫 `x`、乘法必须写 `*`、参数只能单个字母——
    写错时**什么都不画也不报错**
  - 如果你的 profile 只挂了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`（例如用 `dsh plugin add` 手工建的最小 profile），
    预设会停在 `pending (waiting for service: agentPresets)`——**`agentPresets` 由
    `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 提供**，`dsh-base` 不含它。正常走 `dsh web` 建出来的 profile
    两个 bundle 都有，不受影响

---

## 怎么用

切到探究模式，说一个你想搞懂的关系：

> 我想搞懂阻尼振动里那个阻尼系数到底在干什么

它应该**先问你一个具体的、可证伪的预测**（"你猜 d 从 0.2 加到 1.5，波形会怎样？"），**然后**才把带滑块的东西给你，最后要你自己说出规律。

如果你发现它一上来就画图、或者直接开始讲解——那是 bug，不是设计。

---

## 设计要点

### 核心循环（`skills/inquiry-task/SKILL.md`）

**预测 → 操作 → 观察 → 对质 → 命名**

其中两条是硬性的：

- **没有预测就没有探究。** 要一个具体的、可证伪的预测，**并且要他说出来**——承诺感来自"在看结果之前必须表态"。说不出预测时，说明缺前置知识，应该回去讲最小必要的那一点，而不是硬给任务。
- **对质不能滑过去。** 猜错了要先问"你按什么推的"，针对那个推理修；直接讲正确结论等于把他刚暴露的错误模型又盖回去了。

### 四种任务形态

| 形态 | 往返 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A 实时函数探究** | **零** | 旗舰。`plot` 组件自带参数滑块，拖动即时重绘 |
| **B 预计算族** | 零 | 离散/数据类：多序列图、标签页、可本地过滤的表 |
| **C 单点探针** | 一次 | 状态无法用表达式表达时，验证一个具体判断 |
| **D 本地自检** | 零 | 收尾专用，**不做主菜** |

形态 A 能零往返是因为渲染器的 `plot` 组件内建了参数滑块（`params` + 拖动即时重绘 + y 轴锁定 + `animateTo` 动画），不是我们实现的。

### 硬纪律（六条）

1. **绝不等待回合**——渲染完就结束回合，学习者的操作下一轮从正常输入框回来
2. **不剧透**——观察前任何地方不出现结论，包括组件标题和 `explanation` 字段
3. **围栏里只放可操作对象，教学文字放围栏外**（保证降级可读）
4. **没有渲染器就问数值**——降级路径必须始终存在
5. **不硬塞组件**——一段话能讲清就别画图
6. **先讲最小必要概念，再给任务**

`skills/inquiry-task/references/anti-patterns.md` 列了 8 个反模式，前两条（回合空转、剧透）是一票否决级。

### 为什么"不等待"是第一条

这是从一次真实的失败里学到的：**有人真做过交互式学习活动这条路，后来主动砍掉了整条链路**，理由是旧的 `Question → Reveal` 双工具结构"天然重复轮次，并让模型回合在等待用户期间一直处于运行状态"。

围栏是回答的一部分，不是工具调用。模型一旦"等"，回合就挂在运行中直到用户点一下——界面显示在思考，其实在发呆。所以：**渲染完就结束，把回答交还给普通输入框。**

---

## 目录

```
package.json                         dsh-inquiry-preset（bundle 根）
index.js                             入口桩：市场预检要求有入口文件才收
cordis.patch.yml                     预设声明（persona + 4 组子插件）
skills/inquiry-task/
├── SKILL.md                         核心循环 + 硬纪律
└── references/
    ├── task-shapes.md               四形态 + 表达式硬约束 + 降级路径
    └── anti-patterns.md             8 个反模式

tools/probe-skill-dir.mjs            技能被发现链路的逐环探针
docs/demo.png                        上面那张截图
VERIFICATION.md                      实测证据
AGENTS.md                            维护者/AI agent 的工作规范（改这个仓库前先读）
```

排查"技能没出现"时先跑探针——这条链路上任何一环断了都是**静默**的（路径错返回空列表、frontmatter 不合规只打一条 warn）：

```bash
node tools/probe-skill-dir.mjs      # 退出码 0 = 全通过
```

### 两个不能动的约束（改包时容易踩）

1. **不要给 `package.json` 加 `exports` 字段。** 技能目录路径靠
   `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-inquiry-preset/package.json')` 解析，而 `exports` 一旦存在，
   子路径访问默认被封锁，会抛 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`——表现是**技能静默消失**。
   若确实要加，必须同时显式导出 `"./package.json": "./package.json"`。
2. **不要删 `index.js`。** 它从未被 import，但市场装前预检会从包根解析入口文件
   （`exports["."]` → `main` → 兜底 `index.js`），拿不到就判"缺入口文件"并拒收。

---

## 状态

**已在真实会话中实测通过。** 装配层（`preset-inquiry` → `active`、组装树正确）、静态层（技能名与
frontmatter 合规、persona 变量引用全部已注册、内嵌 spec 语法合法）、端到端（技能被加载并影响模型
行为、模型先问预测再给图、`dsh-ui` 围栏渲染成带参数滑块的曲线图）三层全部验过。

首次真实会话测试未发现功能性问题。

详见 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)。

# dsh-web-search-duck

Web search provider for the DSH `ctx.web` seam. It bridges any OpenAI **Responses-API-compatible** endpoint that supports the `web_search_preview` tool: the query is sent to the endpoint, and `url_citation` annotations in the response are mapped to a concise answer plus deduplicated sources.

Registers search provider id `duck-responses-search`.

## Configuration

| env | meaning | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_ENDPOINT` | Responses API endpoint URL | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_MODEL` | model name sent in the request | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_CREDENTIAL` | DSH credentials-store key used for `Authorization: Bearer` | `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_TOKEN` |

Without endpoint/model configured the provider throws a clear error instead of guessing.

## Enable

Point the web seam at this provider in your host patch:

```yaml
- id: web
  override:
    searchProvider: duck-responses-search
```

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.readme_text:
# Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)

Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.

## Why it needs a plugin

`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards only a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.

## The seam that works

```
spawn_teammate_routed            record route by (Lead, teammate name, context)
        ↓
agentTeams.spawnTeammate(...)    shipped Team service, unchanged contract
        ↓
ctx.agents.create()              child materialized; initial prompt queued to inbox
        ↓
agent/pre-step (child scope)     ← plugin: claim route, rewrite child.options
        ↓
AgentLoop.prepareRequest()       reads this.options → request/header + assistant
                                 message source + every later step
```

Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
  `prepareRequest()` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every** step
  (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
  share one `options` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creation and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name must be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback for a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was the first implementation's fatal flaw.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable providers, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.

## Allowlist

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes outside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never restricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.

## Config

```yaml
- id: team-model-routing
  name: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing'
  config:
    toolName: spawn_teammate_routed
    listToolName: list_teammate_models
    freshProvider: spawn
    forkProvider: fork
    routeTtlMs: 120000
```

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they must name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).

## Known limits

- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
  while the child is created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
  Harness **restart** falls back to the `agentOptions` recorded in its
  `subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable record and
  is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `Agent`
  interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
  one-line change; upstream, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
  `agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (or to accept `agentOptions` on
  the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept external PRs
  — publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
  existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

## Test

```sh
node packages/team-model-routing/test/logic.test.mjs
```

18 checks over route validation, allowlist enforcement, discovery rendering, the
claim store, and teammate-name extraction. It covers `logic.js` only — the
`agent/pre-step` seam itself needs a live run.

## Install

Published as [`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing)
on npm, source at [Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing).

```sh
npm install dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
```

or point the plugin manager at the installed package or a workspace directory:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: 'install_bundle', target: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing' })
```

Installing loads the module once; because Node caches ES modules by resolved
path, **replacing this package's code requires a Harness restart** to take
effect in a running process.

## Repository layout

```
index.js            Cordis Host plugin: tools, routing hook, Provider wiring
logic.js            dependency-free routing/claim logic (unit-tested)
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: this row + the tool-agent-team config
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata
test/logic.test.mjs the 18-check logic suite (not shipped in the npm tarball)
```

`npm pack` ships `index.js`, `logic.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`,
`locale/*.json`, `LICENSE`, and both READMEs.


## Verified live

Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's
`subagentModelSelection` allowlist enabled:

| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', reasoning_effort: 'high' })` → host log `team-model-routing: teammate "confirm-route" now runs on model-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` reads the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
| Allowlist rejects before creation | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'bosc', model: 'gpt-5.6-luna' })` → `Error: teammate LLM route "bosc/gpt-5.6-luna" is not allowed by the Subagent model-selection allowlist; allowed: model-server/glm-5.3, kimi-code/k3, bosc/gpt-5.6-sol, model-server/kimi-k3, bosc/deepseek-flash` — no teammate was created. |
| Both tools are live in the Lead scope | `Tool.listTools` lists `spawn_teammate_routed` (with `provider`/`model`/`reasoning_effort`) and `list_teammate_models`. |

Not covered by the live run: the `fork` context, and route survival across a
teammate cold-resume (see Known limits).

## Releasing a new version

The package is `dsh-plugin` shaped: `dsh.bundle.patch` points at
`cordis.patch.yml`, the manifest carries display `meta`, `icon.svg`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`,
and it is `type: module`. To release:

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` (npm rejects a re-publish of an existing version).
2. `node test/logic.test.mjs` — 18 checks must pass.
3. `npm pack --dry-run` — confirm the tarball is the 10 files listed under
   [Repository layout](#repository-layout).
4. `npm publish` — the npm account has 2FA enabled, so pass `--otp=<code>` or use a
   granular token with **bypass 2FA** enabled. When a code is needed, ask for one
   interactively rather than storing it.
5. `git commit` and `git push` the release.
6. If the package name ever changes, update the `name:` line in `cordis.patch.yml`
   to match — the Loader resolves the row by that string.

## Inviting t

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-doctor

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）装上「已经实测过可用性」的 OpenCode 模型路由。**

哪些模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁 —— 装完在选择器里一眼看到；被封锁的自动走你本地的代理，额度还能一条命令查出来。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.18-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![GitHub topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 0.2.2 更新了什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🤝 **官方插件一起装** | `dsh-opencode-go` 成为本插件的依赖并被自动激活 —— 不用再单独装一次，额度胶囊和账号设置页直接可用 |
| 🔌 **代理端口可改** | 新增 `--proxy` 参数和 `OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY` 环境变量，端口不再是硬编码 |
| 🔍 **`check` 会查冲突** | 直接报出「你自己的 patch 会覆盖掉本插件的路由」和「`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入」这类静默问题 |
| 📌 **安装带 tag** | 安装命令固定到版本 tag，不再装浮动的 `main` |

### 0.2.0 有什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🌏 **地区限制自动跳过** | 15 个被地区封锁的模型自动走本地代理（默认 `127.0.0.1:7897`），其余模型继续直连，互不影响 |
| 🔑 **网关自包含** | `dsh-model-proxy` 已写成依赖，装插件时自动装上，不用你另外找东西装 |
| 🧹 **标注更干净** | 已经修好的问题不再写在模型名里 —— 「地区限制」这几个字已经消失 |
| ★ **常用模型清单** | 10 个最常用的模型加了 ★，选择器里输入 ★ 直接筛出来 |
| 📊 **额度查询** | 新增 `usage` 命令：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月，一屏看完 |
| 🐛 **协议分派修复** | 之前模型碰到「地区限制」就停止换协议，会被错误地塞进 OpenAI 路由；现在会继续试到真正能跑的那条 |

## 解决什么问题

网关的 `/models` 接口告诉你它**能提供**什么，不告诉你你**有权用**什么。

地区封锁、余额不足、只限官方客户端的免费层 —— 这些只有真的发一次请求才会暴露。等你选中模型、写好 prompt、按下回车，才发现它根本跑不了。

这个插件把这件事**提前做完**：79 个模型，每一个都真发过一次请求，结论直接写进模型名。

## 效果

DSH 的模型选择器只渲染模型名（不显示描述字段），所以可用性结论就写在名字里：

```
★ Claude Opus 5.5
★ Claude Sonnet 5.5
★ Grok 4.7
★ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
★ GPT-5.3 Codex
Claude Fable 5（需充值）
Cat Jam Free（限官方客户端）
```

**已经修好的问题不再标注。** 地区封锁的 15 个模型现在由插件自己走代理，名字里干干净净 —— 之前的「（地区限制）」字样不会出现了。

顺带的好处：选择器自带模糊搜索。

- 输入「**★**」→ 只剩常用模型
- 输入「**需充值**」→ 筛出余额不足的那组
- 输入「**限官方客户端**」→ 排除只能官方客户端用的免费层

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fffcodefox/dsh-opencode-doctor#v0.2.2
```

**tag 一定要带。** 不带 tag 装的是浮动的 `main`，别人拿到的版本无法复现，你以后往 main 推什么都会直接打到所有已安装的人身上。

装完**重启 dsh**，进 **设置 → 模型**，就能看到下面这些新路由。

> **官方插件一起装好了。** `dsh-opencode-go` 写在本插件的 `dependencies` 里，安装时自动带上，并由本插件的 patch 自动激活 —— 你**不需要**再单独装一次，也不需要把它加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。额度胶囊、账号设置页都跟着一起来。
>
> 不想要它？在自己的 profile patch 里写：
>
> ```yaml
> - id: opencode-go
>   disabled: true
> ```

> **纯配置插件。** 它的全部行为都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不跑任何运行时代码（`lib/index.mjs` 的 `apply` 是空的，只为符合插件规范）。所以它不会影响 DSH 宿主的稳定性，也不会碰你的其它配置。
>
> 唯一的例外是上面那条 `opencode-go`：它会让官方插件在同一个 profile 里跑起来。两个插件可以共存（路由 id 不同），代价是同一个模型在选择器里出现两份 —— 想只留带标注的那份，用官方插件自己的 `modelVisibility` 把它的模型藏掉。

## 地区限制是怎么跳过的

探测发现 15 个模型在中国大陆被封锁（`unsupported_country_region_territory`）。插件不再只是把它们标出来，而是让它们**走代理出去**：

```
你在 DSH 里选 gpt-6-luna
        │
        ├─ 命中代理清单？──是──→ 127.0.0.1:7897 ──→ opencode.ai   ✅
        │                              （探测不到就自动回落直连）
        └──────────────否────────────→ 直连 opencode.ai             ✅
```

- **按模型分流，不做全局代理。** 只有清单里的 15 个模型走代理，其它模型一点不受影响 —— 不会出现「本来能直连的模型被代理带慢」的情况。
- **清单是精确 id，不是通配符。** 避免误伤本来正常的模型。
- **没代理也能用。** `fallbackToDirect` 打开着：代理连不上时，这些模型退回直连，行为和你没装插件时一样。
- **只拦 opencode.ai。** 出口规则限定在这个域名。

### 代理端口不是 7897 怎么改？

默认值 `http://127.0.0.1:7897` 只是 Clash Verge / Mihomo 的常用端口，**不是要求**。三种改法，按省事程度排：

**1. 命令行重写（推荐）** —— 重新生成 patch，端口跟着写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render --proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
```

`probe` 接受同一个参数，重探模型时会一起写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe --proxy http://127.0.0.1:10809
```

不想每次敲参数，就设个环境变量，`render` / `probe` 都会用它：

```bash
OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 npx dsh-opencode-doctor render
```

当前生效的值不用猜 —— `npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 第一行就会打出来。

**2. 在 profile patch 里覆盖** —— 适合不想动插件目录的人：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: model-proxy
  name: dsh-model-proxy
  config:
    enabled: true
    proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:7890"   # ← 只改这里
    origins:
      - opencode.ai
    models: [ ... 原样抄过来 ... ]
    fallbackToDirect: true
```

DSH 的 patch 是**整体替换** `config` 对象（不是深合并），所以要连 `origins` / `models` 一起抄过去，只改 `proxy` 那一行。

**3. 直接改插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml`** —— 能跑，但升级插件会覆盖，不推荐。

**端口写错了会怎样？** 不会崩。`fallbackToDirect: true` 让这些模型回落直连 —— 行为和没装插件一样，只是那 15 个地区受限模型连不上。而且它们名字里**不带**标注（插件认为已经修好了），所以如果你发现它们报错，第一个要查的就是这个端口。

> **只留一条 `model-proxy` 行。** 如果 `dsh-model-proxy` 也被单独列在你 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，它自带的 patch 会再插一条（默认 7890）—— 两条同 id 的行是**串联**而不是覆盖，请把那个名字从 bundles 列表里删掉。`npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 会把这种情况直接报出来。作为本插件的依赖，它照样装着、能被解析到。

## ★ 常用模型

选择器里没有「收藏」这个功能，但名字可以模糊搜索 —— 所以把最常用的 10 个模型加了 ★ 前缀，**输入 ★ 就只剩它们**：

`Claude Opus 5.5` · `Claude Sonnet 5.5` · `Claude Haiku 5.5` · `GPT-5.3 Codex` · `Grok 4.7` · `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash` · `GLM-5.3` · `Kimi K3` · `Qwen3.8 Max` · `MiniMax-M3`

同一个模型出现在多条路由上时会**都**带星，所以不管它最后落在哪个协议，都筛得出来。

## 额度查询

不用再登网页翻额度，一条命令：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage
```

```
OpenCode Go 额度  st_96e…c4d9 ← ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY

  窗口             已用  用掉                   剩余   重置
  滚动窗口 rolling  41%  ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░    59%   10-16 01:18
  本周     weekly   49%  ██████████░░░░░░░░░░    51%   10-19 08:00
  本月     monthly  24%  █████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    76%   11-13 23:55
```

- 三个窗口就是官方面板里的滚动窗口 / 本周 / 本月，`剩余 = 100 − 已用`。
- 进度条到 70% 变黄、90% 变红，快用完了一眼就能看出来。
- 加 `--json` 可以接进脚本。
- key 只以 `st_96e…c4d9` 这种打码形式显示，不会完整打印。

## 覆盖范围

路由按**实际能跑通的协议**生成，所以不是每个网关都有三条。下面是发布时的实测结果（探测日期见 `models.catalog.json`）：

| 路由 id | 协议 | 可用 / 总数 | 端点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 2 / 2 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 30 / 31 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 4 / 4 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 7 / 8 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 11 / 21 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 13 / 13 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |

**合计 67 个无标注 / 79 个模型下发**，覆盖 Claude、GPT、Grok、DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi、MiniMax 等系列。其中 15 个靠上面的代理才能连上。

同一个模型在不同协议下的可用性并不一致 —— 比如 Zen 的 Claude 只认 Anthropic Messages，`grok-4.7` 只认 Responses，`gpt-6-luna` 只在 Responses + 代理下能跑。`probe` 会逐个协议试，把模型归到它**真正能跑**的那条路由上。

## 标注词汇

| 标注 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| （需充值） | 账户余额不足 |
| （限官方客户端） | 免费层模型，只能在 OpenCode 官方客户端里用 |
| （需授权训练数据） | 需要先授权用你的数据训练 |
| （暂不可用） | 其它失败 |

**没有标注 = 探测时可用。** 地区封锁的模型**不在这里**：它们已经被插件修好（走代理），所以名字里不留字。

> 探测内部仍然会记录「地区限制」这个结论（`models.catalog.json` 里的 `code: region`）—— 它决定了谁进代理清单。只是不再写进模型名。

## 凭证

插件从 `refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY` 读 key，按这个顺序找：

1. 环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`
2. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（默认 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）的 `refs` 块
3. OpenCode 自己的 `auth.json`（`~/.local/share/opencode/`、`$OPENCODE_DATA/`、`%APPDATA%\opencode\`）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  OPENCODE_API_KEY: st_xxxxxxxx
```

已经装过 `dsh-opencode-go` 的话，key 名是同一个，**不用重复配置**。

**你的 key 不会被写进插件或仓库。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有 `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY` 这个变量名，key 本体在 DSH 启动时从上面这些位置读，请求时放在 `Authorization` 头里发给 opencode.ai —— 和官方客户端做的事一样。

## CLI

装完之后有个 `dsh-opencode-doctor` 命令（`npx dsh-opencode-doctor` 也行）：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor list      # 看目录里有什么、哪些被标注（离线）
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage     # 查 Go 套餐额度：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月
npx dsh-opencode-doctor check     # 凭证、两个网关、以及组合冲突，一次查完
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe     # 重新探测，重写 catalog + patch
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render    # 只从 catalog 重新生成 patch（离线）
```

`probe` 会对每个模型真发一次请求，结果写回 `models.catalog.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`。日常用不着跑 —— 只有网关更新了模型、或你想重新确认一遍时再跑。**重跑 probe 也会自动刷新代理清单**，网关哪天放开某个模型的地区限制，它会自动回到直连。

常用参数：`--gateway <slug>` 只测一个网关、`--concurrency <n>` 并发数、`--timeout <ms>` 单请求超时、`--key <key>` 直接给 key、`--proxy <url>` 出口代理（`probe` / `render` 用）。

`check` 不打网络请求也能干活 —— 它先读本机配置，把**会让插件静默失效的组合**报出来（你自己的 patch 覆盖了 `llm-pi-ai`、`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入），然后才去验证凭证和网关。装完插件先跑一次这个。

## 常见问题

**我没有代理，装了会不会变差？**
不会。代理连不上时清单里的模型自动回落直连（`fallbackToDirect`），表现和你没装插件一样；其它 64 个模型本来就走直连。

**我本来就在用 `dsh-model-proxy`，会打架吗？**
会重复。`dsh-model-proxy` 自己带的 bundle patch 也会插一条 `model-proxy`（默认 `127.0.0.1:7890`，只匹配 `grok-*` / `gpt-*-luna`）。两条同 id 的行**不会互相覆盖**，而是串成两条 dispatcher —— 于是 `grok-*` 会先去敲 7890。把它从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表里删掉即可：它作为本插件的依赖仍然装着、

plugins.description: dsh plugin that syncs pi.dev model listings into the pi-ai catalog and llm-pi-ai settings — new provider models become selectable without hand-editing node_modules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pi-ai-sync

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis plugin that keeps
provider routes in step with the pi.dev gateway by maintaining **both** layers a
model has to pass through:

- the **pi-ai catalog** (`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<route>.json`)
  — the "does dsh know this model and which protocol does it speak?" layer, and
- the **settings model list** (`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models`) — the
  "does the model picker offer it?" layer.

It is the fusion of
[`dsh-model-sync`](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-model-sync) (settings seam) and
[`dsh-opencode-go-models`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-go-models)
(pi-ai catalog file), with no hand-maintained protocol/family tables: pi.dev's
listing already carries every record in pi-ai catalog shape.

## Why

dsh resolves a configured model's wire protocol as
`route.api ?? catalog[id].api ?? sharedCatalogApi(route)`. On the dsh 0.1.x line
the settings model schema has **no per-model `api` field**, so:

- routes with a single protocol are fine — the route-level api fills the gap;
- a **mixed-protocol** route (`opencode`: anthropic-messages +
  openai-completions + openai-responses + google-generative-ai) has no shared
  api, so any model missing from the installed catalog is rejected outright:
  hand-adding it errors, and a settings-only sync has to drop it.

`dsh-pi-ai-sync` fixes the root cause instead of working around it: it copies
the missing records into the installed catalog, then lets the (now complete)
catalog serve the route.

## How it works

```
one round, per managed route
  1. GET https://pi.dev/api/models/providers/<route>     (catalog-shaped records)
  2. catalog layer  → copy records the installed catalog is missing into
                       dist/providers/data/<route>.json
                       (atomic write + first-modification backup)
                       ⇒ the model becomes base-matching; restart needed
  3. settings layer → reconcile llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models
                       (unset by default; mirror/keep optional)
```

A **layer** is where the data lives (the pi-ai catalog / the `llm-pi-ai`
settings); a round touches both, in that order, for every managed route.

Because the catalog is imported into memory at boot, step 2 only takes effect
after a dsh restart — a round that added models reports `restartNeeded`.

## Install

Not on npm yet — install it from GitHub today:

```bash
# newest `main` (what you want while the plugin is still young)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync

# a pinned release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync#v0.1.0

# or from a local checkout:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pi-ai-sync
```

Restart dsh afterwards (bundle-layer change).

### GitHub installs need the build script allowed

A `github:` install runs the package's `prepare` script (never
`prepublishOnly`), because the TypeScript sources are the only thing in the
repository — `lib/` is gitignored. pnpm blocks install-time scripts by default,
so add the key it prints to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  "dsh-pi-ai-sync@git+https://github.com/jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync.git": true
```

Use that form, not a bare `dsh-pi-ai-sync: true` (pnpm cannot match a name to a
git source) and not the commit-pinned `…/tar.gz/<sha>` form pnpm's own error
message suggests — the pinned key goes stale on the next push, the `git+https`
key does not. dshmarket's "allow build scripts and retry" button writes both
forms for you.

Integrity note: the tarball your install resolves to is the tag/commit you
asked for, and the build happens on your machine from those sources. Use
`#vX.Y.Z` when you want a reproducible environment.

### Behind a proxy

This plugin reaches pi.dev with Node's global `fetch`, which **ignores**
`http_proxy` / `https_proxy` unless Node is told to read them. On a network
that only reaches pi.dev through a proxy, a round fails with a bare
`TypeError: fetch failed` — and only sometimes, because the direct route is
usually still there for other hosts. Start dsh with:

```bash
NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 dsh web          # Node >= 24; see: node --help | grep proxy
```

(`--use-env-proxy` is the same switch as a CLI flag.) `NO_PROXY` is honoured
either way. This is a host setting on purpose: reading the environment from
inside the plugin would mean taking on an HTTP-proxy dependency, and this
package has none.

## Configuration

Edit the `pi-ai-sync` section of your settings document (on the dsh 0.1.x line
that is `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
pi-ai-sync:
  managedRoutes:
    - opencode
    - opencode-go
  settingsMode: unset
  intervalMinutes: 240
```

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `managedRoutes` | `[]` | Routes to sync; empty = `opencode`, `opencode-go` |
| `settingsMode` | `unset` | `unset` removes the route's `models` override; `mirror` rewrites it from pi.dev; `keep` leaves settings alone |
| `catalogSync` | `true` | Maintain the installed pi-ai catalog files (the core layer) |
| `updateExistingModels` | `false` | Also refresh records the catalog **already has** with the fields pi.dev states today |
| `intervalMinutes` | `240` | Auto-refresh interval; `0` = startup only |
| `startupDelaySeconds` | `5` | Delay before the first auto round |
| `refreshTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Abort budget for one round's request |
| `fetchAttempts` | `3` | Fetch attempts per route, with exponential backoff; `1` disables retrying |
| `syncNotify` | `true` | Log the report when there was something to report |
| `keepCatalogOnly` | `true` | In `mirror` mode, also write ids that exist only in the catalog |

### Choosing `settingsMode`

`models` **replaces** the served catalog. dsh resolves
`configured.length > 0 ? configured : catalog`, so a non-empty list stops the
catalog's own list from being used at all. That is what makes the three modes
different things:

| Value | What it does to `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models` | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `unset` (default) | removes the key; `modelOverrides` is deliberately left alone | you want the enriched catalog to be the single source of truth — the plugin's design |
| `mirror` | writes the full list: pi.dev entries the catalog can back, plus catalog-only ids as bare `{ id }` | you want the list visible and editable in settings (dsh-model-sync's behaviour) |
| `keep` | nothing — the catalog layer only | you manage the list entirely yourself |

Notes worth knowing before you pick:

- `mirror` **rewrites the whole list every round**, so hand-edited fields on it
  do not survive. To hand-tune a model, leave `models` out — see below.
- `mirror` refuses a route with non-empty `modelOverrides`: dsh rejects the two
  together ("models already replaces the served catalog").
- `keep` does **not** mean "the catalog decides". If you leave a non-empty
  `models` list, that list is still what serves the route.
- `keepCatalogOnly` (default `true`) is what holds catalog-only models in the
  mirror list; `false` drops them from the picker.

### Hand-tuning a model without `models`

When a route has **no** `models` key, dsh builds the list from the catalog and
then applies `modelOverrides` per id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/v1
      modelOverrides:
        step-5-preview-free:
          maxTokens: 65536
```

The route then offers every catalog model, with your values layered on. This is
the shape `settingsMode: unset` leaves in place. dsh enforces three rules:
`modelOverrides` may only name ids the installed catalog describes, it cannot
sit beside a non-empty `models`, and its fields are `name`,
`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, `reasoningEfforts`, `compat` — no
`api` and no `id` (the id is the dict key).

### Why some ids are "catalog-only"

Two lists move independently:

- the **catalog on disk** — the factory snapshot plus every id past rounds
  merged in, and merges are add-only;
- **pi.dev's live listing** — which gains and drops models over time.

An id the catalog has and pi.dev currently does

# Whalesong Studio · 鲸歌工坊 — website

The project page of [Whalesong Studio](https://github.com/xuhao1/whalesong-studio) (鲸歌工坊), the long-form fiction plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one static page in two languages, served by GitHub Pages from the root of `main` at <https://whalesong.xuhao1.me> (`CNAME`).

- `index.html` — the page; Chinese and English side by side (`lang="zh"` / `lang="en"`), the language switch keeps the choice in `localStorage`; `?lang=en` or `?lang=zh` picks one.
- `style.css` — light theme, no web fonts, no scripts beyond the language switch.
- `img/` — the cover (drawn with GPT Image through Codex), the icon, `og.jpg` for link previews, the screenshots (`shots/en` is *Alice's Adventures in Wonderland* in the English interface, `shots/zh` is 《红楼梦》 in the Chinese one) and portraits drawn in the Studio (`people/`).

Preview locally: `python3 -m http.server` in this folder, then open <http://localhost:8000>.

The screenshots and pictures come from the plugin's repository (`docs/images/readme/`, and the Studio's own pictures of the two demonstration books). The books are in the public domain.

plugins.description: This repo is a deepseek harness plugin for routing auto review (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review) reuqests to user specified model
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-review-model-router

Route DSH's experimental **auto-review** safety gate to a model you choose, so a
premium agent model does not pay for its own safety reviews.

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

With that entry every review runs on `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` while the
agent keeps `claude-opus-4`, `gpt-6-astra`, or whatever else the session selected.

## The problem it solves

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` reviews each gated tool call by
calling `ctx.llm.stream()` on **the session's own route**: it copies `provider`
and `model` out of the session request header
(`snapshotAutoReview()` in `packages/experimental/auto-review/src/index.ts`).
There is no `reviewModel` field in the shipped plugin, so an expensive agent
model is charged for one extra full review request per gated call.

## How it works

The plugin wraps two service methods at activation: `llm.stream` always, and
`llm.prepareCall` unless `wrapPrepareCall` is off.

1. A request is recognized as an auto-review call when it is **hand-built**
   (it does not carry the agent loop's own-request mark) **and** its `system`
   prompt starts with auto-review's fixed `REVIEW_POLICY` opening. Only such a
   request is ever rewritten.
2. It is copied onto `reviewModel`, and the source route's `reasoningEffort` and
   `maxTokens` are dropped. Both are properties of the *agent's* model: a
   reasoning effort the target does not declare makes the harness throw
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`, and an inherited output cap can exceed the
   target's limit. Either would fail every review closed.
3. Everything else — the review prompt, its policy system prompt, `temperature`,
   and the `{"risk":…,"decision":…}` JSON protocol the gate parses — is
   unchanged. Only the model that produces the verdict changes.
4. A review that fails transiently is retried on the same route
   (`retryAttempts`, default 4). The gate calls `llm.stream` directly, outside
   the agent loop, so the harness retry plugin (an `agent/request-error`
   listener) never sees a review: without this, one dropped connection denies
   the tool call.

### Why retries need their own classification

Only the codes the harness itself treats as transient are retried:
`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TRANSPORT`. `TIMEOUT` is deliberately
excluded — the DeepSeek adapter raises it from an **idle watchdog**, so retrying
it multiplies a silent wait by the attempt count while the auto-review deadline
drains. `ABORTED` (the deadline, or the caller cancelling) and configuration
errors such as `AUTH` are not fixed by trying again.

A failed attempt's terminal `finish` chunk is held back: the gate's reader ends
the review on any terminal `finish`, so yielding it would end the review on the
first transport blip. Reasoning chunks stay live (the reader ignores reasoning
content), so a retried review exposes more than one attempt's reasoning while the
verdict is still parsed from the final text block alone.

### Why the wrappers, and not an `llm/stream` listener

Two seams were tried first and both are dead ends on a real runtime:

- Mutating the request inside an `llm/stream` listener throws: auto-review
  freezes it (`deepFreeze`) before streaming.
- Returning `next(replacement)` from a listener never reaches the adapter:
  Cordis's `EventsService.waterfall` invokes the innermost callback with the
  argument list it closed over.
- Writing `ctx.llm.stream = wrapper` is also ineffective: `ctx.llm` is a
  per-read traceable proxy, and its property overlay shadows what you write.

The wrappers are therefore installed on the object that owns each method in the
service's prototype chain (`LlmRuntime.prototype` in practice), which is the one
seam every consumer actually calls. Both are removed when the plugin's fiber
disposes.

### Why `prepareCall` needs its own wrapper

A prepared handle resolves its route during `prepareCall` and then rejects a
dispatch whose config differs from the resolved one
(`INVALID_PREPARED_CALL`). The retarget must therefore happen *before* the call
is prepared; swapping the route in the returned handle cannot work. With
`wrapPrepareCall: true` (the default) a review prepared that way runs on the
review route, and turning it off restores the session route for that path.

## Install

Published on npm as `dsh-auto-review-model-router`:

```sh
# in the profile directory
pnpm add dsh-auto-review-model-router
```

From a local checkout instead, link it:

```jsonc
// <profile>/package.json
"dependencies": { "dsh-auto-review-model-router": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-auto-review-model-router" }
```

Then insert it in the profile patch layer, after the auto-review bundle:

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

Restart the app: patch-layer changes apply at profile startup.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reviewModel` | `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` | `<provider>/<model>` every review runs on. An empty string disables routing. |
| `systemPromptPatterns` | the shipped `REVIEW_POLICY` opening | Substrings, or `/regex/u` literals, matched against a request's `system` prompt. Widen this only if a harness release rewrites that prompt. |
| `retryAttempts` | `4` | Retries after the first attempt of one review call, so up to 5 attempts. `0` disables retrying. Maximum 10. |
| `retryDelayMs` | `500` | Pause before each retry. |
| `wrapPrepareCall` | `true` | Also route review requests issued through `llm.prepareCall`. |
| `dropReasoningEffort` | `true` | Drop the source route's reasoning effort on the review request. |
| `dropMaxTokens` | `true` | Drop the source route's output cap on the review request. |
| `logRetargets` | `true` | Log each retargeted review. Retries log a warning regardless. |

## Verify

The test suite has two files. `test/router.test.js` covers the decision surface
with no harness at all; `test/live.test.js` runs the wrappers over the real
`LlmRuntime` and skips those checks when neither this package nor
`DSH_PROFILE_DIR` resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`.

```sh
node test/router.test.js
DSH_PROFILE_DIR=<profile dir> node test/live.test.js
```

Two commands rather than `node --test`: each file runs its `node:test` suite
in-process, while `node --test` spawns a child process per file.

> The plugin patches `LlmRuntime.prototype`, so each live test disposes its own
> mount. Skipping that teardown leaks a wrapper into the next test's dispatches.

At runtime each retarget logs one line, and each retry logs a warning:

```
auto-review-model-router: review request re-routed anthropic/claude-opus-4 -> deepseek-official/deepseek-flash (stream)
auto-review-model-router: review attempt 1/5 failed with TRANSPORT; retrying in 500 ms
```

## Scope and limits

- Only requests recognized as auto-review calls change route. A false negative
  costs nothing (the review runs exactly as before); a false positive is bounded
  to one extra object and one changed route for one hand-built request.
- The standalone `dsh-auto-review` plugin needs none of this: its `reviewerModel`
  config field already sets the reviewer's model directly.
- DSH public APIs are pre-stable. A release that changes the `REVIEW_POLICY`
  opening, `LlmRuntime.prototype`'s method names, or the prepared-handle contract
  needs a matching update here. Detection is configurable
  (`systemPromptPatterns`) precisely for the first case, and the plugin logs a
  warning instead of failing the profile boot when a method it needs is missing.

## License

MIT

# dsh-media-gen [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key already configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.** ## Features - Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation card or command. - Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for image or video generation. - Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default). Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session. - English and Japanese UI; command responses are English. ## Compatibility Choose a release for your DSH version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen/releases). Supported versions and changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Replace `` with the full release tag you selected: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen.git#' ``` The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be authenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile. To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs the latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-media-gen ``` Restart DSH after removal. In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key. ## Usage

*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation edited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.* ### Generation cards and chat Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options. - **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details. - **Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first. You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/image --count` instead repeats the same prompt. Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card using the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft. Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval. ### Commands Place options before the prompt and quote paths containing spaces with `"`. | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--yes] ` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs | | `/video [--model id] [--duration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] ` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames and reference images | | `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediately | | `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults | | `/media-model image` | List image model IDs | | `/media-model image [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation | | `/media-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection | | `/media-approval on` | Allow generation in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation | | `/media-approval off` | Restore normal per-request confirmation | Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; selections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own model argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card model through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection. ### Approval and costs Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent requests ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conversation permission; only the user can change it. Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second generation call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `requireApproval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them. Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges. Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image request fails, already saved images are returned with the failure. ### Video jobs Jobs resume tracking after a DSH restart when storage is available. Completed files are downloaded automatically; completion, failure, or expiry is reported to the session when it is open. Jobs started with `/video` do not wake the agent on completion; use `/media-jobs` or wait for the next agent turn. After `videoMaxWatchMs` (3 hours by default), tracking stops. This does **not** cancel the provider job or guarantee a refund. plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xwide-handoff

> 给 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 用的交接插件：一条 `/handoff` 把「快聊满的会话」变成「一张结构化交接卡 + 一个干净的新会话」，并在侧栏自动置顶。上下文快满时还能**自动把下一棒备好**。

[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff?include_prereleases&label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff/releases/latest)
[![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81-beta-orange)](docs/INSTALL.md)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6-blue)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

**中文（本页）** · [English](README.en.md) · [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

> **状态：v0.2.2 · beta。** 核心流程（`/handoff` → 交接卡 → 新会话 → 自增命名 → 置顶）在作者机器上长期在用；跨机器安装路径（尤其 `childMode: none`）**尚未在第二台机器验证**。安装两步、配置项表、五条故障排查见 [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md)。

---

## 它解决什么问题

长任务会把会话上下文顶满。官方的自动压缩是**有损**的：它会把细节吃掉，而且压完你还在同一个会话里，继续顶。

这个插件换一条路 —— **交接**：

1. 把「当前做到哪一步 / 改过哪些文件 / 验证过什么 / 下一步做什么」写成一张**交接卡**；
2. 起一个**上下文清零的新会话**，把卡片作为它的第一句；
3. 新会话**自动命名**（`原会话名_01`、`_02`…，落盘计数器，不重名）、**自动置顶**、**自动归入源会话所在的项目分组**。

于是你换了个房间，但接力棒没丢。

## 安装

```bash
# 在 DSH profile 目录里
pnpm add dsh-xwide-handoff
```

**下载即用（不需要 npm / pnpm）**：把本仓库整个目录放进 `<你的 profile>\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\`，然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一行挂载，**重启 DSH**：

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    enabled: true
    commandName: handoff
    childMode: create
    recentUserMessages: 6
```

> ⚠️ **只能有一个装载实例**：包自带 patch 插一条 + profile 再直装一条 = 两个实例（命令注册两次、watcher 双份）。现象是启动日志里 `/handoff registered` 打印两次。详见 [故障排查①](docs/INSTALL.md)。

## 用法

指令菜单里能看到 `handoff` 这一条（说明命令已注册），或在输入框直接敲 `/handoff`：

![DSH 指令菜单里的 handoff 命令](docs/img/handoff-command.png)

```
/handoff 本次重点：把 X 的解析逻辑改完；已改 a.js；未验证回归
```

- `/handoff` 后面写的内容会进卡片的「本次交接重点」。
- **不写也行** —— 卡片会自动带上「本轮动过的文件」和「你最近 6 条原话」。
- 命令执行完会告诉你新会话的 id 和标题，并把它置顶。

**注意**：`/handoff` 是斜杠命令，**只能由用户在输入框敲**，模型不能自己调用。所以插件同时提供 A 半自动（见下），到阈值时**替你把它备好**。

## A 半自动（`autoReady`）

打开后，插件监听每一轮的结束（`turn/end`），读最近一次请求携带的上下文量：

```
占用 = 最近一条 assistant/message 的 usage.inputTokens ÷ contextWindow
```

- **≥ `readyPct`（默认 0.7）** → 自动跑一遍交接：建会话、命名、置顶、注入卡片、驱动它跑完首轮（这样它在侧栏里**一定看得见**）。
- **不替你切会话** —— 你从侧栏点那条置顶的新会话继续。DSH 没有「服务端让浏览器换会话」的公开接口，这是有意的边界。
- 保险丝：同一会话只备一次、全局冷却（默认 10 分钟）、总开关默认**关**。

> ⚠️ 判占用**必须**用 `inputTokens`。`usage.totalTokens` 是累计消耗（见过 20 万），拿它判会 100% 误触。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    commandName: handoff          # 命令名，默认 handoff
    childMode: create             # none | create | fork（见下）
    recentUserMessages: 6         # 卡片带最近几条你的原话
    compact: false                # 交接前是否先本地压缩一次（本地大模型请保持 false）
    titleTemplate: '{base}_{seq}' # 标题模板，支持 {base} {seq} {note} {time}
    seqWidth: 2                   # 序号位数：_01
    maxTitleChars: 64             # 标题字符上限
    repinLimit: 3                 # 自愈重钉次数上限
    autoReady: false              # A 半自动总开关
    readyPct: 0.7                 # 触发阈值（占上下文窗口比例）
    readyCooldownMs: 600000       # 冷却
    contextWindow: 262144         # 上下文窗口（判占用用；默认取自作者的本地模型，请按自己窗口改）
    cardSections:                 # 卡片栏目开关
      guide: true                 # 「接手须知」
      files: true                 # 「本轮动过的文件」
      usage: true                 # 「源会话上下文」
```

### `childMode` 三档

| 值 | 行为 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | 服务端直接建**全新空会话**（上下文清零，继承 cwd 与 agentPreset） | **默认推荐**。不依赖客户端半边 |
| `none` | 服务端不建会话，把卡片 JSON 塞进结果文本，由 `client.js` 用 GUI 原生 API 建**可见**会话 | 需要「和点『新建对话』完全一致」时；要求 `client.js` 已正确作为 `dsh.client` 打进包，**跨机器未验证** |
| `fork` | 继承全部历史（上下文**不**清零） | 只想换个标题、不想清上下文的场景 |

> ⚠️ 三种模式都**不能**带 `parentSession` —— DSH 会把带 `parentSession` 的会话从列表和可恢复集合里排除，那正是「交接完看不见新会话」的经典成因。

## 交接卡长什么样

```markdown
调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07          ← 第一行 = 目标标题（官方取名启发式直接取它）

# 交接卡 · 调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07

## 接手须知（先读这一段）
1. 先读完整卡片：源会话 cwd 下的 handoff/ 目录里最新那份 .md 就是本卡全文
2. 先报计划再动手：一句话说清先做哪条、大约要多久、有没有分支
3. 不要重复已完成步骤：下面「本轮动过的文件」都改过了，先读现状
4. 拿不准就去查证：文件、目录、会话记录都在磁盘上

- 源会话上下文：约 18461 tokens（最近一次请求携带量；判占用看它，不看累计消耗）

## 本轮动过的文件（3 个，自动提取自 5 次 write/edit 调用）
- `C:\…\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\index.js`（write×1 edit×4）

## 最近你的原话（逐条原文，按时间顺序）
1. …
```

## 工作原理（给要改代码的人）

- **命名**：序号来自落盘计数器（`~/.dsh/named-handoff-counter.json`，按 cwd 分桶单调递增），**不是**从源会话标题尾号推算 —— 源会话每次都是新开的、标题没有尾号，推算永远得到 `_01`。名单落在 `~/.dsh/named-handoff-names.json`。
- **钉名三通道**：① 卡片第一行就是目标标题（官方取名服务会读它）；② `ctx.sessions.using(...).binding.session.rename()`（部分版本没有 `using`，会失败）；③ `session.append("session/title", …)`。
- **自愈重钉**：官方取名服务会主动覆盖已钉住的标题（其注释自认 "overwriting a pinned user title is the point"），所以插件监听改名事件，发现名单内会话被非 user 来源改名就再钉一次（上限 `repinLimit`）。
- **`prompt` 需要 signal**：`sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` 的包装层第一行就调 `signal.throwIfAborted()`，务必传 `new AbortController().signal`。
- **`blank` 只认 `turn/start`**：侧栏会把 `blank: true` 的会话直接滤掉（标题还会显示成「新建会话」）。注入消息不会翻这个标记，所以必须真的驱动一轮。

## 兼容性

本插件使用了若干 **DSH 内部接口**（不是稳定公开契约），已在下列位置核对过：

| 用到的东西 | 位置（DSH 桌面版内置包） |
|---|---|
| `sessionController.prompt / create / resolveAgent` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` |
| `session.append` 的 `surfaceOp` 语义 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`（`SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 只有 system/developer/user/assistant/message + tool/result） |
| `system/message` 必须是 surface 第一条 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4` `foldSurface()` |
| `workspaceRegistry.pinSession` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace` |
| `projectController.baseline / assign` | `dsh-project-groups`（**可选依赖**，没装就跳过归组） |
| 侧栏 `blank` 过滤 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` |

**DSH 升级后请复核上表**。所有内部调用都写了宽容处理：失败只记日志，不让交接本身崩掉。

## 路线图

- [ ] `childMode: "none"` 客户端半边的完整接线与回归
- [ ] 卡片栏目可自定义模板
- [ ] 交接卡自动带上「已跑过的关键命令」
- [ ] 发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场，实现一键安装

## License

MIT © 2026 XWIDE

plugins.readme_text:
# Reply Suggestions

**简体中文** · [English](./README_EN.md)

根据上一轮对话，自动推荐下一句提问。回车填入，编辑后再发送。

一个为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供输入框推荐的插件。助手回答结束后，输入框为空时显示灰色推荐；按回车将它变成可编辑的草稿，不会自动发送。

| 项目 | 当前版本 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件 | `0.1.17` |
| 已核对的官方桌面版 | `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2` |
| 许可证 | [MIT](./LICENSE) |

## 功能

- 根据最近一次用户问题和助手回答，生成一条相关的后续提问。
- 第一次按 **Enter** 把推荐填入草稿，可继续编辑；之后按 Harness 原有规则发送。
- 按 **Escape** 隐藏当前推荐。
- 保留中文输入法确认和 Shift/Ctrl/Command/Alt+Enter 的原有行为。
- 输入框有草稿、附件、引用或待处理队列时延后生成；任务运行时不显示推荐。
- 使用 Harness 已配置的模型和凭据，不需要另填 API Key。
- 在插件详情页查看历史总量、今天、昨天、近 7 天和近 30 天的推荐 Token 用量及人民币费用估算。
- 在详情页点击“更新价格”，或默认每 7 天自动检查官方价格表。

## 演示

![灰色推荐与按 Enter 填入草稿](./assets/reply-suggestions-demo-0.1.16.png)

演示由真实 0.1.16 客户端的测试夹具输出生成，并置于模拟对话页面；非 DSH 桌面实录。对话和推荐为演示数据，没有调用模型。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装

1. 打开 DSH 的 **插件** 页面，先检查是否已安装 `dsh-reply-suggestions`。已安装时使用更新入口，避免重复添加。
2. 确认官方桌面版为 `0.2.0-rc.2` 或 `0.2.1-rc.2`。
3. 点击 **添加插件**，在“包名或地址”中填写：

   ```text
   https://github.com/jabingu/dsh-reply-suggestions
   ```

4. 按应用提示完成加载并启用，重启 DSH。
5. 完成一次普通对话，保持输入框为空，等待灰色推荐出现。

仓库包含构建好的 `lib/`，安装前无需自行构建。DSH peer 声明支持 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2`；其他版本需要先核对接口。

如果升级到 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 后看到 `0.1.16` 的不兼容提示，将插件更新到 `0.1.17`，再完全退出并重启 DSH。本地链接安装只需更新链接目录中的文件后重启，已有用量记录继续保留。

### 从本地目录安装

下载仓库 ZIP 并解压，或克隆仓库。检查插件尚未安装后，在同一添加入口填写包含 `package.json` 的目录绝对路径，启用后重启 DSH。

官方桌面 profile 由应用管理，请使用桌面插件页面。确实使用 `dsh web` 的用户可在插件目录执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list --depth=0
# 确认尚未安装后再添加：
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

更新本地链接安装时，更新已链接目录中的文件并重启 DSH 即可，无需重复安装。

## 使用示例

发送：

> 请用两三句话解释什么是插件，并举一个生活中的类比。不要调用工具或创建文件。

回答完成后，可能出现“能给我一个最简单的插件示例吗？”的灰色推荐。按一次 Enter 填入，修改后再发送。具体内容由模型生成，随对话变化。

## 模型与 token 消耗

每次生成推荐会额外调用一次模型，即使没有采用推荐，也已产生该次请求的用量。默认沿用助手回答记录的 provider/model；rc.2 记录缺少元数据时，使用会话当前模型投影。

插件通过以下方式限制开销：

- 只读取上一轮正文，不传整段历史、推理块或附件内容。
- 用户问题最多 **400 个字符**，助手回答最多 **1,200 个字符**；客户端和 Host 均执行限制。
- 长文本保留约前三分之一和后三分之二，中段标记省略；Markdown 围栏代码块在本地省略，保留周围说明及行内代码。
- 使用较短提示词，输出上限为 **96 token**；此上限不包含输入 token。
- DeepSeek 的推荐请求关闭深度思考，不改变主对话的推理设置。
- 输入框可用且空闲 **800 毫秒**后才请求；等待期间开始输入会取消定时器。
- 已发起请求后输入文字会暂时隐藏推荐，结果可在清空草稿后复用，避免取消重试。切换会话、开始新一轮或卸载仍取消旧请求。
- Host 最多缓存 64 条已完成结果，最多同时生成两条推荐。

相比旧版，上下文上限从 14,000 降到 1,600 字符，减少约 88.6%；这不是每次实际 token 的节省比例。压缩可能让推荐忽略回答中段和代码细节。插件不额外调用模型进行摘要。

## 用量统计

打开 **插件 → Reply Suggestions**，可查看历史总量及四个时间范围的已记录 Token、输入（含模型缓存）/输出 Token、请求次数，以及未返回用量、失败和取消的请求次数。

“历史总量”汇总开始记录以来的全部有效请求，包括超过 30 天的记录；直接按请求去重汇总，不把四个重叠时间范围相加。费用按每次请求保存的价格估算，缺少用量或价格时标明未知/部分；开始记录前没有保存的历史无法补回。

统计精简为两张卡片：左侧默认显示今天，可通过下拉菜单切换昨天、近 7 天或近 30 天；右侧固定显示历史总量。切换直接使用已读取的数据，不增加模型或统计请求。

Token 数量自动显示 K（千）、M（百万），最多保留两位小数，例如 `12K`、`1.23M`；不足一千显示整数。总量与输入/输出均采用此格式，实际记录和费用计算仍使用完整 Token 数。

- 使用 DSH 模型流返回的实际 `usage`，不把字符估算当成真实 Token。
- 近 7 天、近 30 天包含今天，按 DSH Host 的本机时区和自然日汇总。
- 只记录本插件生成推荐的请求，不统计主对话、其他插件或查看统计的 RPC。
- 本插件复用已生成推荐时没有新模型请求，不重复计数；提供方报告的缓存 Token 仍包含在输入统计内。
- 一次请求收到多条累计用量，只保存最后一条有效用量，不累加重复快照。失败/取消时已返回的用量也计入；未返回用量则标注为“未知”，不假定为零。
- 数据在重启后保留，记录开始时间也会显示。升级前没有记录的历史无法补回。
- 页面打开时每 15 秒刷新，也可手动点击“刷新”；刷新不会调用模型。

记录保存在 Harness 数据目录的 `storages/dsh-reply-suggestions/usage.jsonl`，遵循 `DSH_HOME`，默认位于 `~/.dsh`。不同 profile 使用同一数据目录时共享本插件的统计。文件保存记录编号、时间、请求状态、Token 数；从 0.1.8 起还保存实际请求的 provider/model 和价格版本，不保存对话正文、附件或凭据。无法保存或读取记录时，页面会标明统计可能不完整。

### 费用估算

每张卡片显示人民币 API 公开价估算，范围为空闲价～高峰价。读取用量仅使用本地价格；更新价格时直接读取官方网页，不调用模型。以下为插件内置的 [DeepSeek 官方价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)，核对日期 2026-10-14，单位为元/百万 Token；联网成功后新请求使用获取到的价格：

| 模型 | 输入未命中（空闲/高峰） | 输入缓存命中（空闲/高峰） | 输出（空闲/高峰） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Flash | 1 / 2 | 0.02 / 0.04 | 4 / 8 |
| Pro | 4.5 / 9 | 0.15 / 0.30 | 13.5 / 27 |

费用 =（输入减缓存命中）×输入单价 + 缓存命中×缓存单价 + 输出×输出单价，再除以一百万。范围不推测中国法定节假日，不代表实际账单、赠送额度或套餐扣费。

- 官方 `deepseek` / `deepseek-account` 的 Flash、Pro 使用各自价格；Flash 的官方兼容名称使用 Flash 价。其他 provider/model 不套用此价格，标记为未计入费用。
- 0.1.6/0.1.7 的记录缺少模型名称，保留原记录，并明确标注“历史请求按 Flash 假设估算”。如果当时使用其他模型，此部分金额不适用。
- 未返回用量、价格未知或记录早于对应价格生效日的请求不估算，不当成免费；部分可计算时显示“部分”。费用范围按每条记录计算后汇总。
- 新请求在生成推荐前保存完整价格快照，即使生成期间调价，仍按开始请求时的价格估算。更新不会重新计算旧请求的价格；0.1.8 的旧价格版本继续保留。
- 微小费用保留最多六位小数，低于 ¥0.000001 的非零费用仍显示“小于 ¥0.000001”。

### 更新价格

在 **插件 → Reply Suggestions → 推荐 Token 用量** 下方点击 **更新价格**，立即检查官方人民币价格表。它与“刷新”按钮独立：刷新只读取用量，更新价格才会访问网页。页面显示上次成功检查、下次检查及失败原因。

在“自动更新周期”下拉框选择 **每天、每 3 天、每周（7 天）、每 30 天、仅手动更新**。选择后自动保存并生效，重启后保留。保存失败时保留原周期；选择“仅手动更新”仍可点击“更新价格”。

- 默认每 7 天检查；Host 每小时判断是否到期。首次启动或到期后重启会立即补检查，DSH 关闭期间不运行。
- 自动更新失败后等 24 小时再重试，手动按钮随时可重试；同一 Host 中同时触发的更新共用一次请求。
- 仅访问官方价格页的规范地址 `https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/`，15 秒超时，不使用 API 密钥、不发送对话、不跟随跳转。
- 严格解析 Flash/Pro、人民币、每百万 Token、输入未命中/缓存命中/输出及空闲/高峰价格。网络不可用、币种/单位不符、字段缺失或页面结构变化时保留已有价格，并提示失败。
- 缓存及检查结果追加保存到 Harness 数据目录的 `storages/dsh-reply-suggestions/prices.jsonl`；重启后恢复，避免重复检查。价格无法落盘时会提示当前价格可能仅在本次运行有效。
- 未在详情页选择过周期时，使用配置中的 `autoUpdatePrices` / `priceUpdateDays`（默认每 7 天，允许 1～30 天）。详情页保存的选择优先于这些初始配置，随 `prices.jsonl` 恢复；共享同一数据目录的 profile 也共享这项选择。

## 可选配置

一般无需配置。如需指定其他已在 Harness 配置好的模型，可在使用中的 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

```yaml
- id: reply-suggestions
  config:
    enabled: true
    timeoutMs: 20000
    autoUpdatePrices: true
    priceUpdateDays: 7
    provider: your-configured-provider
    model: your-configured-model
```

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否生成推荐 |
| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | 超时毫秒数，允许 1,000～60,000 |
| `provider` | 跟随对话 | 可选，必须是已配置的提供方 |
| `model` | 跟随对话 | 可选，必须是该提供方可用的模型 |
| `autoUpdatePrices` | `true` | 自动检查价格；设为 `false` 时仍可手动更新 |
| `priceUpdateDays` | `7` | 自动检查周期，1～30 天；失败后 24 小时重试 |

失败、超时或输出不符合要求时，输入框保留普通行为。可在客户端控制台查找 `[reply-suggestions]` 诊断。

## 开发

开发要求 Node.js 22 或更高版本。已在 Windows x64 的 Node 22.23.3 和 24.16.0 上实际验证，无需安装构建依赖：

```powershell
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm test` 自动枚举测试文件，避免 Node 22 和 Windows 下通配符展开的差异；可使用 `npm test -- --test-reporter=dot` 显示简洁结果。

[Node compatibility](./.github/workflows/test.yml) 工作流在 push、pull request 和手动触发时，分别在 Windows、Linux 上测试 Node 22 和 24。每个任务执行构建、构建产物一致性检查、全部测试、客户端语法检查及 `npm pack`。工作流随代码推送到 GitHub 后生效；本地验证不代表云端任务已经运行。

桌面插件使用 DSH 内置运行环境，以上 Node 测试不替代桌面视觉和输入法验收。

```text
src/common.mjs       RPC 契约、上下文压缩、键盘保护
src/engine.mjs       模型请求、预算、缓存与超时
src/usage.mjs        持久化用量记录和自然日汇总
src/pricing.mjs      官方人民币价格版本及费用范围计算
src/price-updates.mjs 官方网页解析、定期检查与价格缓存
src/index.mjs        Host 服务注册
src/client.cjs       灰色推荐、生成时机、草稿填入
lib/                 已构建的 Host 和客户端文件
locale/              插件名称和中英文介绍
scripts/build.mjs    无额外构建依赖的打包脚本
scripts/test.mjs     跨平台测试文件枚举及运行脚本
.github/workflows/test.yml Node 22/24 的 Windows/Linux 自动测试
tests/               行为和客户端生命周期测试
```

实现使用官方 Typert/Gateway RPC、`llm.stream`、`conversation.input.overlay` 槽位、会话快照和草稿动作。已核对两个支持版本的 composer DOM 标记、草稿动作及详情页槽位，版本变更时需要重新检查。

## 验证范围

- `0.1.17` 修正 `0.1.16` 精确锁定旧 DSH 版本造成的加载拦截，明确兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2`。使用新版 DSH 自带的兼容性检查代码验证通过；已用新版 Cordis、Typert、Host/Client Gateway 和 home-paths 检查推荐、用量、费用、价格更新、周期保存及重启恢复。模型和网络采用测试替身，不改真实记录；未重新完成新版桌面视觉及真人输入法验收。
- Node 22.23.3 和 24.16.0 分别通过 66 项自动化测试，覆盖推荐交互、占位节点生命周期、用量及历史总量去重、日期边界、费用计算、价格更新及周期保存、失败回退、重启恢复和统计页面卸载。0.1.17 验证日期：2026-10-18。
- `0.1.16` 修复并发相同请求重复调用模型、输入框重复挂载产生重叠推荐，以及损坏价格缓存警告被错误清除的问题。两个 Node 版本均通过真实 rc.2 库的 RPC、缓存计数及重启恢复检查，模型使用 stub；桌面视觉验收仍需单独完成。
- 使用官方 rc.2 安装包中的 Cordis、Typert 和 Host/Client Gateway，验证了实际插件 fiber 的挂载、RPC 和卸载，模型使用 stub。
- `0.1.2` 曾在真实 rc.2 桌面端验证推荐生成、显示、首次 Enter 填入、编辑、Shift+Enter 换行、发送、Escape 和会话切换。
- `0.1.3` 的用量优化及 `0.1.4` 的展示元数据更新已通过自动化和资源检查；没有重新进行真实模型质量或桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.5` 增加透明 PNG 对话图标，已核对尺寸、透明通道、256 KB 限制和打包清单；未改动推荐或快捷键逻辑。
- `0.1.6` 已用官方 rc.2 Cordis、Typert、Gateway 和 SlotCore 检查用量 RPC、详情页注册及缓存计数；真实桌面详情页显示四个统计卡片，并核对了一条实际推荐的 223 Token 与本地记录一致。刷新统计未增加模型请求。
- `0.1.7` 将占位文字隐藏样式移入输入框组件，并用内联样式隐藏辅助提示，修复返回旧对话时提示文字与占位文字重叠。
- `0.1.8` 加入人民币费用范围估算，真实历史 911 Token（输入 844、输出 67）按 Flash 假设得到 ¥0.001112～¥0.002224；官方 rc.2 RPC 检查和统计组件测试通过，尚未重新进行本版本的桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.9` 加入手动/周期更新：真实访问官方页面、价格保存及重新加载成功；真实 rc.2 Gateway 验证更新按钮对应 RPC，统计与价格检查不增加模型调用。未重新进行桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.10` 将总量及输入/输出 Token 自动缩写为 K/M，最多两位小数。
- `0.1.11` 在详情页增加自动更新周期选择；真实 rc.2 RPC 验证保存及 Host 重启恢复，失败保持旧设置。未重新进行桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.12` 直接隐藏实际占位节点并观察重建，组件之间共用隐藏租约，避免旧实例卸载恢复新实例仍需隐藏的占位文字。已实际验证重启、插件页返回及历史对话切换，观察到单条推荐且无占位文字重叠。
- `0.1.13` 加入历史总量卡片，汇总全部有效记录并沿用 K/M 显示及历史价格。超过 30 天、重复、未知、异常和未来记录测试通过；真实 rc.2 RPC 与 Host 重启恢复验证通过。未重新进行本版本桌面视觉验收。
